title: AH - Gold Loan - Tirupati
description:
Designation:


Location: India Andhra Pradesh Tirupati \- CMR Complex\-1


Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Description: Area Head – Gold Loan**
==========================================

**Location:** Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh  

**Department:** Gold Loan Business  

**Reporting To:** Regional Head / State Head – Gold Loan

**Job Summary**
---------------


The Area Head \- Gold Loan will be responsible for driving business growth, profitability, portfolio quality, and operational excellence across the assigned territory. The role involves managing multiple Gold Loan branches, leading Branch Managers and field teams, ensuring compliance with company policies, and delivering customer\-centric solutions to achieve business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Business Growth \& Revenue Management**

* Drive Gold Loan business across assigned branches in Tirupati and surrounding markets.
* Achieve branch\-wise disbursement, revenue, portfolio, and profitability targets.
* Develop and execute local market strategies to increase customer acquisition and market penetration.
* Identify new business opportunities and expansion potential within the territory.
* Monitor competitor activities, pricing, and customer preferences to enhance market share.

### **Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop Branch Managers and branch staff across the region.
* Ensure adequate manpower availability and productivity across branches.
* Conduct regular branch reviews and performance discussions.
* Drive employee engagement, training, and capability\-building initiatives.
* Foster a high\-performance and customer\-focused culture within the team.

### **Portfolio \& Risk Management**

* Ensure healthy portfolio growth while maintaining asset quality.
* Monitor overdue accounts, auction cases, and portfolio delinquency.
* Implement collection and recovery strategies to control NPA levels.
* Ensure proper appraisal, valuation, storage, and release of pledged gold as per policy.
* Minimize fraud risks through regular monitoring and process adherence.

### **Operations \& Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to RBI regulations, internal policies, audit requirements, and operational guidelines.
* Conduct regular branch visits to review operational controls and compliance standards.
* Drive resolution of audit observations and ensure timely closure.
* Monitor customer service standards and grievance resolution mechanisms.
* Maintain process discipline and operational efficiency across branches.

### **Relationship Management**

* Build strong relationships with customers, local influencers, and business associates.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams including Credit, Operations, Risk, HR, and Finance.
* Strengthen the company's brand presence within the assigned geography.
* Support marketing and promotional initiatives to drive business growth.

### **MIS \& Reporting**

* Track business performance through regular MIS reviews.
* Prepare business forecasts and action plans to achieve targets.
* Present branch performance reviews and market insights to senior management.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting of business metrics.

**Desired Candidate Profile**
-----------------------------

### **Education**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA or Post\-Graduation preferred.

### **Experience**

* 7 to 12 years of experience in Gold Loan, NBFC, Banking, or Financial Services.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in managing multiple branches/territories.
* Strong exposure to Gold Loan operations and business development.

### **Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Expertise in Gold Loan products and operations.
* Business development and market expansion capability.
* Portfolio and risk management experience.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Proficiency in MIS reporting and performance management.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
-------------------------------------

* Gold Loan portfolio growth.
* Revenue and profitability achievement.
* Customer acquisition and retention.
* Branch productivity and business performance.
* Portfolio quality and NPA control.
* Audit and compliance score.
* Employee productivity and attrition management.
* Customer satisfaction and service standards.

### **Span of Control**

* Branch Managers, Assistant Branch Managers, Relationship Officers, and Branch Operations Teams across the assigned territory.

**Preferred Location:** Candidates with strong market knowledge of Tirupati and Andhra Pradesh Gold Loan business ecosystem will be preferred.

description:
Designation: Chief Manager


Location: India Maharashtra ABHI One India Bulls


Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Purpose:**

  

To drive recruitment of high\-quality insurance agents through effective planning, execution and governance of the FLS (Front Line Sales) network. The role focuses on building a strong agency workforce, ensuring consistent talent inflow, improving agent productivity, and strengthening the recruitment capability of the field sales team.

**Key Responsibilities:**

 **1\. Recruitment Strategy \& Planning**

* Design and implement a comprehensive recruitment strategy to achieve monthly and annual agent recruitment targets.
* Translate organizational growth objectives into regional and branch\-level recruitment plans.
* Develop FLS capacity and productivity plans to ensure optimal manpower availability for agent recruitment.
* Identify new sourcing channels (referrals, digital, campus, local activations) to broaden recruitment reach.

 **2\. Execution \& Governance**

* Drive FLS hiring effectiveness and ensure each FLS meets agent recruitment productivity norms.
* Monitor recruitment funnel metrics – prospecting, interviews, licensing, and activation – and address drop\-offs.
* Conduct weekly/monthly recruitment reviews with Zonal/Regional/Branch Heads to track performance and action plans.
* Implement recruitment dashboards and MIS for real\-time performance visibility.

 **3\. Capability Building**

* Strengthen recruitment capability of the FLS and Sales Leaders through training, tools, and best practices.
* Partner with L\&D to design and roll out Recruitment Excellence Programs for the sales force.
* Develop recruitment champions and reward high\-performing FLS for consistent agent onboarding.

 **4\. Process Excellence \& Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with IRDAI licensing norms and documentation requirements.
* Drive adherence to recruitment SOPs, background checks, and quality standards for agent onboarding.
* Collaborate with Operations and HR to ensure seamless agent onboarding and activation processes.

 **5\. Analytics \& Insights**

* Use data analytics to forecast recruitment trends, identify underperforming zones, and predict shortfalls.
* Track recruitment cost metrics (cost per agent hired, active agent ratio, etc.) to ensure efficiency.
* Provide strategic insights to leadership for decision\-making and manpower planning.

title: Apprentice
description:
**Who we are looking for**

Our program is designed for Apprentices to gain valuable experiences alongside on\-the\-job training both technically and professionally towards becoming our future leaders and technology experts. You’ll learn from some of the most respected highly qualified people in the industry and be supported by individual mentors and development programs.


The role requires attention to detail and good understanding of coding, design, development of applications and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodologies. Our Apprentices will get an opportunity to work with State Street Technology Services at Hyderabad and Bangalore office locations.


**Why this role is important to us**

Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence, and robotics process automation. We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end\-to\-end, next\-generation financial services company.


Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems, and make your mark on our industry.


**What you will be responsible for**

As an Apprentice you will be:


* Analyzing the business/ technical requirement documents
* Contributing to the application design, development, testing and deployment
* Participating in agile team meetings such as Stand\-up calls and retrospective meetings
* Preparing the technical documentation required for adopted SDLC process.
* Collaborating with various State Street internal teams
* Develop and maintain applications with Java and SQL.
* Functional Testing, Database SQL, Manual TestingReactJS/AngularJS with node
* Presentation Skill, Excel Reporting/PowerBI/Tableau, Communication skill, SharePoint, Power Automate
* Automation QA, Selenium, Java, Python, Rest assured QA Automation
* PowerBI/Tableau, SQL, Data Modelling
* Core Java with strong knowledge of OOPS concepts and Data Structures
* Monitoring Tools \- Splunk/Dynatrace \& Grafana for Presentation/Dashboards

**What we value**

These skills will help you succeed in this role:


* Combination of academic aptitude, analytical capabilities, and excellent communication
* Strong critical thinking, problem solving and decision\-making skills.
* Display a culture of individual ownership of tasks to embed a clear individual sense of accountability in performing the role.
* Ensure that the highest level of the Code of Conduct is displayed in your behavior.
* Support the ‘Risk Excellence’ culture within the business.
* Adhere to limits of delegation and escalation procedures required by your manager so that you comply with internal policies and external regulations.

**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**

* B.Tech/M.Tech/MCA degree or equivalent or related field
* Working knowledge and skills in GUI development with Java middle and databases back\-end to create an end\-to\-end solution desirable.
* Understanding software development lifecycle and software development common practices (code reviews, unit testing etc.)
* Good understanding of SQL performance tuning techniques including query plan understanding and management, SQL tracing, DB stats, indexing techniques etc., highly preferred
* Good in managing and resolving problems on a live production system.
* Candidates must be fresher and available to work on a full\-time basis from Sept 2025\.

**About State Street**

**What we do.** State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data \& analytics, investment research \& trading and investment management to institutional clients.


**Work, Live and Grow.** We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance, and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.


**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.** We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift programs and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.


State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.


Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers


**About State Street**
======================

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

This role builds the team, infrastructure, and knowledge base needed to support HR service delivery, while navigating global HR rules and client\-specific cases to maintain compliance and adherence to regulatory standards across the region.

-------------------------

* Serve as the regional subject matter expert for HR processes, country\-specific requirements, and client\-specific case handling.

title: Head of Talent
description:
This position is with Manifest Global, which also includes trailblazer brands such as Cialfo, Explore, BridgeU, and Kaaiser.
**What This Role Is**



By 2030, the world will need 85 million more skilled workers than it has today, and 375 million people will need to reskill as AI reshapes the industries that keep economies running. Every institution that finds, develops, and places talent, whether for a company, a university system, or a country, is being rebuilt around that shift right now. Most of them are rebuilding slowly, with the same processes they used a decade ago and AI bolted on at the edges.



Manifest doesn't have that luxury, and doesn't want it. The business is built on the premise that talent mobility, at civilisational scale, needs an AI\-native operating system, not a faster version of the old one. That premise applies as much to how Manifest builds its own team as it does to the students, schools, and universities it serves. A company that tells the world it is building the infrastructure for how human talent finds opportunity cannot run its own Talent function on spreadsheets and instinct, and cannot treat workforce planning as an afterthought to the business plan rather than the thing that makes the business plan achievable.



This role owns Talent at Manifest globally, in full: the hiring engine, the employee experience, the leadership bench across every business unit, the workforce plan that keeps the org ahead of the business rather than reacting to it, and the AI\-powered infrastructure that ties all of it together. You are the person who translates talent into the language the executive team and the board already use for revenue and margin: capacity, capability, retention, and risk.



You own building Talent into the kind of high\-performing, self\-sustaining organisation that Manifest expects every function to become, and proving that Talent can lead by example rather than trail behind.


**What Makes This Role Different**



Most talent leadership roles inherit a function built for a single business, in a single market, with a stable headcount. This one spans five brands, multiple geographies, and a growth model built substantially through acquisition, which means the workforce plan, the leadership bench, and the AI infrastructure you build all have to absorb new companies and new people on short notice, repeatedly, without losing coherence. That is a materially harder systems and leadership problem than most "Head of Talent" titles are asked to solve, and it is why the Manifest ecosystem, the ability to move people, standards, and leadership talent across five connected businesses, is the advantage no standalone competitor for this hire can offer you.



The timing is specific. Manifest is scaling its reach across more than 150 countries at a moment when the broader overseas education industry is contracting and Manifest is growing. Building the workforce plan, the leadership pipeline, and the AI\-native infrastructure now, while the function is still being shaped rather than fixed in place, is a materially different opportunity than doing it later, after the patterns have hardened.


**Why This Is Worth Your Next Decade**



Most people who lead Talent at this level inherit an org chart and a reporting calendar and are asked to run both well. You are being asked to decide what the org chart should be, build the workforce plan that keeps pace with a business growing across borders, and prove that a talent function can operate with the same rigor, and the same voice at the table, as finance or product. Companies that get this right in the next five years will define how the next generation of global companies build their people functions, and how talent leadership earns a genuine seat in the room rather than an invitation to it. You would be one of the people who decided what that looks like, for Manifest and for the industry watching how Manifest does it.


**What You Own**


**Talent Acquisition and the Hiring Engine**


* Own the hiring strategy and standard across every brand, every geography, and every level, from individual contributor to executive search
* Build a sourcing, screening, and closing engine that runs on AI\-native tooling as the default, not the exception
* Set the bar for what a great hire looks like at Manifest, and hold every part of the function accountable to it


**Talent Operations and the Employee Experience**


* Own the full employee lifecycle globally: onboarding, offboarding, compliance, compensation coordination, people analytics, and workplace support
* Build a consistent standard of experience regardless of brand, geography, or manager
* Ensure Manifest's multi\-jurisdiction footprint runs with the same rigor a business its size requires


**High\-Performing Teams, Leadership Development, and Succession**


* Build and coach a Business Partnering team embedded in every business unit, operating as strategic peers to the leaders they support, not a support function
* Own leadership pipeline and succession coverage across the group, so every critical role has a named path to readiness rather than a gap discovered under pressure
* Set the standard for what a high\-performing team looks like at Manifest, and build the manager capability that makes that standard repeatable rather than dependent on any one leader


**Strategic Workforce Planning and Business Alignment**


* Own the workforce plan that translates business goals into people requirements, capacity, capability, and retention, the same way a financial plan translates strategy into numbers
* Build the forecasting discipline that keeps hiring, mobility, and org design ahead of the business plan rather than reacting to it
* Own Talent's presence in quarterly business reviews and board reporting, making the workforce as measurable and as credible as revenue


**Talent AI and Infrastructure**


* Build a dedicated capability that makes Talent AI\-native from the ground up: sourcing, screening, onboarding, workforce analytics, and decision support, all running on AI rather than layered with it afterward
* Own the systems architecture that connects every part of Talent into one coherent function instead of several
* Bring the same technical standard to Talent that Manifest brings to its own products


**Executive Partnership and Talent Thought Leadership**


* Be the strategic talent voice at the table when the CEO, COO, and business unit leaders are shaping direction, including on acquisitions from the earliest stage
* Represent Manifest's point of view on talent and AI\-native people practices externally, as part of how the company is known in its markets, not just how it hires into them
* Set the intellectual agenda inside Manifest for how leaders think about their people, so talent becomes a discipline every executive is fluent in, not a function they delegate to


**What Success Looks Like**



The markers below reflect where Talent is today. We will calibrate the specifics once you are in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.



In the first months, you have formed a clear, specific point of view on how the workforce plan should connect to the business plan, on where the leadership bench is strong and where it needs building, and on what the AI\-native infrastructure underneath all of it needs to look like. You have earned real credibility with business unit leaders and with the executive team as someone who understands their commercial reality, not just their headcount requests.



By mid\-period, Talent runs measurably differently: the workforce plan is a standing input to business planning rather than a reaction to it, succession coverage exists for every critical role, and the function is visibly AI\-native in how it sources, hires, and supports people across every brand. Talent's reporting to the executive team and the board is as credible and as data\-driven as finance's.



In the long term, you have built a Talent function, and a leadership bench beneath you, that other companies point to as a model, and that Manifest's own executive team points to as proof that talent strategy and business strategy are the same conversation.



The specifics will be calibrated once you are in the role. The direction won't change.


**What You Bring**



You have built and led talent functions at real scale before, across more than one country and more than one business line, because the coordination problem here is not theoretical. You think about Talent the way a strong general manager thinks about a business: as a set of interconnected systems and bets, workforce planning, leadership development, hiring, infrastructure, not a collection of HR processes running in parallel.



You have built high\-performing teams before, and you know the difference between a team that performs because of one strong leader and a team that performs because the systems, the bench, and the standards make it repeatable. You are fluent in workforce planning as a genuine discipline: translating a business plan into a people plan, forecasting capacity and capability gaps before they become urgent, and making the case for headcount and investment in terms the executive team finds credible.



You are genuinely fluent in how AI changes talent work, not as a talking point but as a practitioner, and you know the difference between AI as a feature bolted onto an old process and AI as the foundation a process is rebuilt around.



You have a real point of view on talent and you are comfortable being the voice that carries it, inside the executive team and in how the company is known externally. You have led leaders, not just individual contributors, and you hold them to a standard that is honest rather than diplomatic, while still being the kind of leader they would choose to work for again.



Most importantly, you read the description of what Manifest is building, an AI\-native operating system for global talent mobility, and your first reaction was not "that's an ambitious mission statement," it was "I know exactly how to build the talent function, and the team, that proves it's true." That's the person this role is for.


**Why Manifest**



Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for how human talent finds opportunity across borders, an AI\-native operating system that identifies talent, develops it, and places it at civilisational scale. Through Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners), Manifest connects students, schools, universities, and employers across more than 150 countries. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. By 2030, the world will need 85 million more skilled workers than it has today, and 375 million people will need to reskill as industries are reshaped by AI. Manifest is backed by $91M from Tiger Global, Square Peg Capital, Susquehanna Asia Venture Capital, and others. Still early.



For this role specifically: Manifest sells the world an AI\-native way of moving talent across borders. Talent, the function, is where that standard either becomes real inside the company, in the teams it builds and the workforce plan it runs, or stays a claim on a careers page. This role decides which one it is.



Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 150\+ countries.

At Fictiv, you'll be surrounded by supportive teammates who will push you to be your best through their curiosity and passion.  

  



### **Impact In This Role**


This role partners closely with HR, Operations, Quality, Product, and Team Leads but does not own employee relations, policy interpretation, payroll, benefits, leave, disciplinary action, or formal performance management processes. Employee questions or matters outside the learning scope should be redirected to the appropriate HR or management owner.
  

Shift alignment: Operates in the North America shift with partial overlap into the India day shift to support coordination across global L\&D, Operations Product, and HR stakeholders as needed for learning program alignment.
  

Daily learning operations support: Coordinate and support routine L\&D activities including training schedules, onboarding learning logistics, LMS tracking, learner communications, training completion follow\-up, and new\-hire learning progress reporting.


### **What You’ll Be Doing**


**Areas of Responsibility:**


**1\. Training Delivery \& Facilitation**


* Onboarding \& Foundational Training: Facilitate onboarding learning programs for new hires covering company platforms, proprietary software, company workflows, and core product knowledge.
* Skill\-Based Workshops: Deliver training sessions on customer service, professional communication, and quality standards.
* Continuous Upskilling: Conduct regular training sessions on technical system updates, new AI tools, and evolving process workflows.
* Refresher Training: Run quarterly skill reinforcement sessions to fix knowledge gaps and maintain high process adherence among existing staff.
* Blended Learning Delivery: Select and use appropriate learning formats (classroom, virtual, self\-paced, or blended) based on the audience and business needs.
  

**2\. Content Development \& Stakeholder Management**
* Material Creation: Design and build clear instructional assets, including facilitator guides, participant workbooks, presentation decks, quick\-reference job aids, and basic e\-learning modules.
* Content Maintenance: Partner with internal stakeholders, product experts, and team managers to update training materials, process guides, and job aids whenever software, tools, or customer support procedures change.
* Strategic Alignment: Partner with Customer Service (CS) leadership to forecast future growth and map out upcoming training needs for the team.
  

**3\. Coaching \& Performance Evaluation**
* Training Needs Analysis: Review call, email, and workflow examples in partnership with Team Leads and Quality/Ops stakeholders to identify recurring gaps and training needs.
* Skill Coaching: Provide targeted learning reinforcement and practice support to help team members apply training concepts, improve workflow understanding, and strengthen customer support.
* New\-Hire Learning Progress: Track new\-hire learning progress through their first 30\-60\-90 days, coordinating with Team Leads to identify training gaps and provide targeted refresher support.
  

Effectiveness Tracking: Evaluate training effectiveness using knowledge checks, assessments, learner feedback, completion data and post\-training skill application trends.
  

**4\. Training Coordination, Admin \& LMS**
* Logistics Management: Organize training schedules, handle calendar invites, prepare materials, and accurately track session attendance.
* LMS Administration: Manage the Learning Management System (LMS) by uploading digital courses, assigning learning tracks, and keeping user records clean and updated.
* Reporting \& Dashboards: Compile clear reports, summaries, and dashboards on training completion rates, learner feedback, assessment results, refresher needs and learning progress for leadership.
* Vendor Support: Assist with the administrative management of external training vendors, facilitators, or content providers as required.
  

**5\. Culture \& Leadership Enablement**
* Leadership Enablement: Help Team Leads understand training outcomes, reinforce learning expectations, and identify where additional learning support may be needed for their teams.
* Advanced Facilitation: Assist in running workshops focused on global mindsets, strategic thinking, and collaborative leadership.
* Living our Core Values: Help reinforce company culture and core values across the GCC through learning activities, workshops, onboarding content, and manager enablement resources.

**Desired Traits:**
-------------------


**Education \& Experience**


Degree: Bachelor's degree (Education, Business, Human Resources, Engineering or a related field is a plus). Training certifications (like Train\-the\-Trainer) are a bonus.
  

Experience: 2–4 years of relevant experience in training facilitation and content development, (classroom, virtual, or blended). Up to 10 years of overall working experience (ideally in customer service or a GCC).
  

**Technical Skills**
  

LMS: Comfortable using an LMS (Learning Management System) and quick to learn new software.
  

MS Office: Strong skills in PowerPoint, Excel, and Word to create reports and presentations.
  

Process Focus: Ability to read technical data, system updates, and manual procedures, and translate them into simple training points.


**Core Skills \& Attributes**
  

Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication. Confident speaking in front of groups and handling feedback sessions smoothly.
  

Data \& Tracking: Ability to track and interpret learning data, including attendance, completion rates, assessment results, learner feedback, and post\-training application indicators.
  

Organization: Strong planning skills to manage training schedules, deadlines, and materials without losing attention to detail.
  

Mindset: Understands the daily pace of customer support/GCC work, works well with teams, and handles learner data, training records, and sensitive learning feedback with maturity.
  

Travel: Open to domestic and international travel if required.


**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**


We’re actively seeking teammates who:


* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.

title: Manager HR – Learning & Development
description:
**About the Team**



Our Human Resources team operates as a strategic partner to the business, focused on cultivating a high\-performance culture where exceptional talent thrives. Our work is fundamentally guided by the DICE (Democratize Internet Commerce for Everyone) mission, which underpins our approach to all people strategies. Our core mandate centers on two critical pillars: driving world\-class Talent Density and continuously elevating Employee Experience. We achieve this by relentlessly attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber of professionals, ensuring that every individual contributes significantly to our success. Concurrently, we are committed to shaping an unparalleled employee experience—one defined by transparent communication, meaningful development, and a deeply engaging, inclusive culture. As stewards of the company's most valuable asset—its people—we design, implement, and champion people strategies that directly translate into sustained business growth and a position as one of India’s most sought\-after e\-commerce destinations.


**About the Role**



The Senior Manager – HR Learning \& Development role will focus on setting up the Meesho Academy. The aim of the Meesho Academy will be to build employee capabilities that are aligned to our long\-term vision.



The role will initially focus on capability building primarily for our early career hires that come in from campus. It will also focus on upskilling the broader workforce on AI and building skills for a future\-aligned workforce.



### **What you will do**


### To meet the requirements outlined above, you will need to do the following:


* **Needs Assessment:** Conduct problem\-first analyses using data and leader \& employee inputs to identify the needs of the programs.
* **Program Development:** Design programs to cater to the needs which include on\-the job development, learning from others and formal learning. Use AI to create learning programs as needed.
* **Curriculum Development:** Develop AI\-based programs where needed for enabling in\-person training programs. Develop virtual training programs to help up\-skill.
* **Measurement \& ROI:** Define KRs to measure the impact of the training programs on productivity, skill\-building etc.
* Partner closely with the COEs related to employee experience, talent density, manager capability to drive success of our KRs.
### **What you will need**


* Postgraduate degree in Human Resources from premium institutes
* 3\+ years of experience across HR, consulting, or strategic roles
* Strong understanding of multiple HR domains (talent, rewards, culture, org design)
* Ability to go deep in one domain while retaining enterprise\-level perspective
* Strong first\-principles and L2 thinking — able to anticipate second\-order impact of changes
* Exceptional structuring skills (problem statements, frameworks, roll\-out plans)
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Comfort operating with senior leadership
### **About us**



Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.


**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor \- our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**


### **Our Mission**



Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e\-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.



We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state\-of\-the\-art tech infrastructure, and pan\-India logistics network through trusted third\-party partners.



Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi\-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e\-commerce ecosystem.


### **Culture and Total Rewards**



Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people\-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.



Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non\-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our 9 guiding principles, or "Mantras," are the backbone of how we operate, influencing everything from recognition and evaluation to growth discussions. Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.



We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity\-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee\-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness\-related perks.



To support work\-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.



At Meesho, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where every individual can thrive. In compliance with the **Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016**, we uphold the following principles:


* **Equal Opportunity**: We ensure that employment opportunities are never denied on the grounds of disability if the candidate is otherwise competent to perform the job.
* **Accessible Workplace**: Our facilities are designed to be fully accessible, with amenities and assistive devices provided to support differently abled individuals in their work.
* **Inclusive Hiring Process**: We adopt a transparent and non\-discriminatory selection process, including providing application forms in alternate formats and offering reasonable accommodations during interviews upon request.
* **Career Growth**: We provide adequate training post\-recruitment and pre\-promotion, with training materials available in accessible formats to enable equal career progression.
* **Support \& Confidentiality**: A dedicated liaison officer/committee addresses concerns and grievances, while maintaining strict confidentiality of disability\-related information.
* **Awareness \& Inclusion**: We conduct awareness programs to promote a culture of inclusivity across the organization.

Meesho welcomes applicants and employees of all abilities and is dedicated to fostering an environment where differently abled persons can achieve their full potential.



Know more about Meesho here : https://www.meesho.io/

description:

Joining in as "UK Commercial Manager \- BA4", the role will manage and process day\-to\-day procurement, payment and contractor administration activity across Coupa, Coupa Pay, SAP Fieldglass and related systems. The role will ensure requests are raised accurately, approvals are progressed, payments are tracked, and contractor onboarding, extensions and exits are managed in line with business policy and control requirements.


To be successful as a "UK Commercial Manager \- BA4", you should have experience with:


### **Key responsibilities**


* Process and manage Coupa requests, including purchase requisitions, purchase orders, changes and approvals.
* Support Coupa Pay activity, including invoice queries, payment tracking and issue resolution.
* Manage SAP Fieldglass activity for contractors, including onboarding, extensions, rate changes, timesheet queries and offboarding.
* Act as the key point of contact for contractor and supplier administration queries.
* Ensure procurement and contractor records are accurate, complete and maintained in line with internal controls.
* Track open requests, approvals and payment issues, escalating risks or delays where required.
* Work closely with Finance, Procurement, Hiring Managers, HR and suppliers to resolve queries quickly.
* Support reporting on contractor spend, purchase order status, overdue approvals and outstanding payments.
* Identify process improvements to reduce delays, improve compliance and strengthen governance.

### **Critical skills and experience**


* Strong working knowledge of Coupa, including requisitions, purchase orders, approvals and supplier queries.
* Experience using Coupa Pay or similar payment and invoice management processes.
* Experience managing contractors through SAP Fieldglass, including onboarding, extensions and offboarding.
* Good understanding of procurement, purchase order, invoicing and payment processes.
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage data accurately across multiple systems.
* Confident stakeholder management skills, with the ability to chase, escalate and resolve issues.
* Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple requests, deadlines and priorities.
* Good understanding of risk, controls and compliance in a corporate environment.
* Ability to work independently, solve problems and keep activity moving without close supervision.
* Strong Excel and reporting capability to track requests, spend, payments and contractor activity.

### **Essential behaviours**


* Proactive and delivery focused.
* Comfortable working at pace and managing competing priorities.
* Clear and professional communicator.
* Strong ownership mindset.
* Able to challenge gaps or delays constructively.

Reliable, organised and control\-focused.  
* 

This role will be based out of Gurgaon.


**Purpose of the role**


To drive the success of the commercial banking segment through market analysis, product development, sales and relationship management, risk management, and performance.


**Accountabilities**


* Execution of market research to understand the competitive landscape, identify market trends and opportunities, and develop strategies to capture market share within the commercial banking segment, taking into consideration industry, size, and growth stage.
* Development of appropriate pricing models for different products and services, ensuring profitability while remaining competitive in the market.
* Development, implementation and management of innovative financial solutions, services and products aligned to the banks objectives and are tailored to the commercial banking segment, including loan products, cash management solutions, and trade finance services.
* Identification and forging of strategic partnerships with other financial institutions, technology providers, or industry experts to expand product offerings and reach new client segments.
* Management of key stakeholder relationships within target companies to understand their needs and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Development and implementation of sales strategies including the establishment of sales targets, identification of sales channels to reach potential clients and objectives for loan terms to support the negotiation process and development of service agreements.
* Monitoring of key leading and lagging metrics such as new client acquisition, loan volume, revenue generation, and market share to assess the performance of the commercial banking segment. Funnel and journey optimisation are key to delivery of service and commercial performance.

**Analyst Expectations**


* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: HR & Engagement Manager
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a HR \& Engagement Manager based in India.**
 This is a strategic HR opportunity focused on strengthening employee engagement across a complex, multi\-unit organization.
   

  

 You’ll develop and execute an organization\-wide engagement strategy while adapting initiatives to the needs of individual teams and locations.
   

  

 The role combines employee listening, data analysis, leadership development, communications, and change management.
   

  

 You’ll partner closely with senior leaders, HR teams, managers, and cross\-functional stakeholders to turn engagement insights into measurable action.
   

  

 You’ll also shape survey programs, focus groups, reporting, and training resources that help leaders understand and improve employee experience.
   

  

 The position offers significant influence, requiring both strategic thinking and hands\-on execution in a collaborative, matrixed environment.
   

  

 Success will come from translating employee feedback and organizational data into initiatives that improve engagement, retention, performance, and business outcomes.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Develop and implement a comprehensive, sustainable employee engagement strategy aligned with broader organizational priorities and objectives.
* Partner with senior leaders, deans, HR directors, and service teams to establish clear connections between employee engagement and strategic business outcomes.
* Design, coordinate, and evaluate employee engagement surveys in collaboration with HR partners, vendors, and organizational stakeholders.
* Develop engagement metrics and reporting processes that enable the organization and individual units to monitor progress and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Lead employee focus groups and other listening initiatives to complement survey findings and develop a deeper understanding of employee needs.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on engagement data and survey results, producing clear global and local reports with actionable recommendations.
* Develop train\-the\-trainer programs that equip leaders and local teams to interpret engagement data and create effective action plans.
* Create and maintain training materials, tools, resources, and communication content that help leaders translate engagement insights into meaningful initiatives.
* Develop and execute communication plans that build awareness, participation, and ongoing dialogue around employee engagement.
* Leverage events and other engagement opportunities to encourage continuous conversation and participation.
* Identify employee engagement challenges, recommend solutions, and support initiatives designed to improve the overall employee experience.
* Help leaders understand relationships between engagement and outcomes such as employee turnover, healthcare costs, grievances, and organizational or student success.
* Work across functions and locations to identify unique workforce needs while maintaining consistency with the broader engagement strategy.
* Manage and develop a professional training and development team, establishing priorities and supporting high\-quality execution.


**Requirements**
* Master’s degree preferred, ideally in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business, Psychology, or a related field.
* At least 2 years of direct Human Resources experience or experience in a closely related discipline.
* At least 1 year of experience managing or supervising staff.
* Demonstrated ability to lead initiatives, move strategic agendas forward, and deliver measurable outcomes.
* Strong experience partnering with senior leaders, managers, and colleagues to achieve organizational objectives.
* Experience working across organizational boundaries and interacting effectively with employees and leaders at different levels.
* Experience implementing high\-impact HR, employee engagement, organizational development, or people\-focused initiatives.
* Excellent influencing, leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills, particularly within matrixed or complex organizations.
* Strong presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively through verbal presentations, written materials, and executive\-level content.
* Ability to analyze detailed information and numerical data and translate complex findings into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences.
* Experience designing or supporting employee surveys, focus groups, feedback programs, or other employee listening initiatives.
* Experience with event management and employee engagement activities.
* Strong change management capabilities, with experience identifying opportunities to improve organizational effectiveness and efficiency.
* Ability to use stakeholder feedback, trend analysis, and employee insights to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders effectively.


**Benefits**
* Opportunity to lead and shape a broad employee engagement strategy with organization\-wide impact.
* Strategic exposure to senior leaders, HR teams, managers, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Opportunity to influence leadership development, employee experience, and organizational effectiveness.
* A role combining strategy, analytics, communications, training, and change management.
* Opportunity to lead and develop a professional training and development team.
* Collaborative environment with exposure to diverse teams, functions, and organizational needs.
* Opportunity to develop scalable engagement programs, measurement frameworks, and leadership resources.

title: Campus Recruiter
description:
**Job Summary:**


Participates in the recruiting, screening, and interviewing processes to fill current or expected job vacancies. May communicate with applicants and candidates regarding consideration for employment and the specifics of the role.


**Key Responsibilities:**


Recruits, screens and interviews internal and external applicants to fill current or expected job vacancies in alignment with the organization’s recruiting strategies and legislative requirements. Reviews and evaluates applicant's background information in comparison to the job vacancy and facilitates the applicable reference checks, background checks and applicant testing processes. Communicates with candidates regarding their application status; may extend job offers and prepares the appropriate job offer paperwork processes. Informs candidates of jobs duties and responsibilities, compensation and benefits programs, work schedule and conditions, and career advancement opportunities. Ensures the organization's recruiting processes are carried out in accordance with applicable internal policies, procedures and government legislation. Communicates with external recruitment contacts to provide information regarding career opportunities. May travel to recruiting events. Arranges interviews and travel logistics for selected applicants; partners with line human resources to ensure interview and selection process progress smoothly. Collaborates with hiring managers and other key stakeholders in the recruiting process. Utilizes and maintains applicant tracking system including periodic reporting to stakeholders.


**Competencies:**


Action oriented \- Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.


Balances stakeholders \- Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.


Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.


Customer focus \- Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.


Decision quality \- Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.


Demonstrates self\-awareness \- Using a combination of feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into personal strengths and weaknesses.


Interpersonal savvy \- Relating openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people.


Persuades \- Using compelling arguments to gain the support and commitment of others.


Candidate Assessment and Selection \- Defines qualification requirements and selection criteria for open positions using Cummins tools; employs objective selection processes that meet compliance requirements; assesses, evaluates and selects candidates against pre\-determined job specifics and "Select for Cummins" competencies, and communicates openly with candidate and stakeholders to ensure timely hiring outcomes.


External Talent Sourcing \- Identifies and applies appropriate candidate sourcing methodologies and tools to identify, attract and engage a diverse pool of talent in the external market.


Human Resources Business Process Execution \- Manages the execution of Human Resources business processes, seeking efficiency, accuracy, positive business performance outcomes and operational agility; integrates activities across processes as needed; assures compliance with process and legal requirements; effectively balances process requirements and business leader needs.


Human Resources Consulting \- Collaborates with partners to observe the environment and apply sound judgment informed by knowledge, skills, and experiences to diagnose, identify and optimize opportunities to provide holistic solutions, while balancing the needs of stakeholders, primarily employees, with those of the organization.


Data Analytics \- Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.


Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.


**Education, Licenses, Certifications:**


College, university, or equivalent degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field or equivalent experience required.


**Experience:**


Minimal level of relevant work experience required.


This person is responsible for finding and hiring young talent from colleges and universities for the organization.


On a typical day, they:


* Connect with colleges, placement teams, faculty members, and student coordinators to plan hiring activities.
* Build relationships with MBA, engineering, and diploma institutes to strengthen the company's presence on campus.
* Coordinate campus drives, pre\-placement talks, assessments, interviews, and hiring events.
* Work closely with business leaders to understand hiring needs and identify the right campuses to target.
* Screen student profiles, review resumes, and help shortlist candidates for interviews.
* Engage with students to explain career opportunities, answer questions, and maintain their interest throughout the hiring process.
* Manage communication between candidates, hiring managers, and colleges to ensure a smooth recruitment experience.
* Track hiring data, prepare reports, and monitor metrics such as applications received, selection ratios, and offer acceptances.
* Support employer branding initiatives by organizing campus engagement programs, competitions, webinars, and networking events.
* Ensure selected candidates complete documentation and stay engaged until they join the organization.

In simple terms "Think of this role as the bridge between colleges and the company. They attract talented students, build strong campus relationships, coordinate recruitment activities, and ensure the organization hires the best MBA, engineering, and diploma graduates."


What makes someone successful in this role?


* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills
* Ability to manage multiple campuses and hiring projects simultaneously
* Good coordination and stakeholder management
* Data tracking and reporting skills
* Passion for engaging with students and promoting the employer brand
* Problem\-solving and attention to detail

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys networking, event management, stakeholder engagement, recruitment, and building talent pipelines for the future.

title: Senior Associate - Campus Recruiter
description:
**ABOUT BXRE \& THE CATALYST PROGRAM**


Revantage Corporate Services) is a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company providing shared services across Finance, Technology, Legal, HR, and more to Blackstone's global real estate portfolio. Headquartered in Chicago with a growing India GCC in Bengaluru, BXRE operates across six countries and approximately 3,500 employees.


The Catalyst Program is BXRE's inaugural university hiring initiative, targeting fresh graduate and early\-career professionals across multiple tracks to form the Class of 2027\. This is a flagship people investment, designed to build BXRE's long\-term India talent pipeline from the ground up.


This role is a critical internal hire. The Campus Recruiter will be the single owner of the university hiring program from the moment an offer is made through to the end of the two\-year cohort journey — partnering with our campus execution vendor and BXRE leadership to deliver a best\-in\-class early careers experience.

**ROLE PURPOSE**


The Campus Recruiter is the internal nerve centre of the Catalyst Program. This person will own the end\-to\-end university hiring lifecycle — from college relationship management and campus drive co\-execution, through to post\-offer engagement, induction design, and cohort milestone tracking. This is not a sourcing\-only role; it is a program management and early careers specialist position with a direct line to senior leadership.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1\. Campus Strategy \& College Relationship Management**

* Own and manage relationships with Training \& Placement Officers (TPOs) at target Bengaluru\-region and pan\-India institutions year\-round — not just during drive season.
* Co\-develop and maintain the annual institution strategy and campus calendar in partnership with leadership
* Represent BXRE at campus events, career fairs, guest lectures, and pre\-placement talks; coordinate leadership participation.
* Identify and onboard new campus partnerships; continuously refresh the institution list based on yield data and track fit.

**2\. Campus Drive Co\-Execution**

* Plan and run all on\-campus and virtual assessment and interview drives across four tracks.
* Coordinate logistics for all campus events — scheduling, candidate communications, interview panel briefings, and debrief management.
* Manage the assessment process: coordinate proctored online assessments, shortlisting, and structured interview rubrics.
* Ensure offers are rolled within 5 business days of each drive; manage offer documentation and approval workflows in Workday Recruiting.

**3\. Post\-Offer Engagement \& Candidate Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for all offered candidates from offer acceptance through Day 1 joining.
* Run fortnightly post\-offer follow\-up (POFU)— track joining intent, flag at\-risk candidates, manage withdrawals.
* Build and manage the cohort community: WhatsApp group, monthly newsletter, insider content, and pre\-joining engagement events.
* Own document collection, background verification (BGV) coordination, and pre\-onboarding logistics for the full cohort.

**4\. Induction Programme Design \& Delivery**

* Design and run the 4–8 week structured induction program for the Catalyst Class of 2027, covering rotational exposure across Finance, Technology, Legal, and HR functions in close partnership with L\&D.
* Coordinate with business unit heads to assign live project work and structured learning modules during the induction period.
* Facilitate weekly cohort check\-ins, buddy program pairing, and senior leadership fireside sessions.
* Track induction completion and probation readiness; produce handover reports for HRBPs at the end of the induction period.

**5\. Cohort Lifecycle Management (Months 3 – 24\)**

* Track and manage cohort milestones at 3, 6, 12, and 24 months in partnership with HRBPs and People Analytics.
* Support formal probation reviews at 3 months; flag performance risks and attrition signals to the People Technology Lead.
* Coordinate cohort reunion events, mentorship program assignment, and 6\-month pulse surveys (Peakon / Workday).
* Produce quarterly cohort health reports: retention, performance distribution, function placement, and satisfaction metrics.
* Manage the campus ambassador program — engage alumni at the 2\-year mark to return to campuses as BXRE representatives.
* 2\-year attrition target: \<20% across the cohort.

**6\. Stakeholder Management \& Reporting**

* Act as internal bridge between BXRE leadership, HRBPs, and the candidate cohort.
* Prepare weekly / monthly program status reports for the leadership.
* Maintain all program data in Workday Recruiting — candidate pipeline, offer status, joining confirmation, and cohort tracking.
* Present cohort updates to senior stakeholders and PortCo leadership as required.

**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE**

**Essential**

* 5\+ years of experience in campus / university hiring or early careers recruitment, with at least one full campus cycle owned end\-to\-end.
* Prior experience at a GCC, shared services company, Big 4 firm, consulting firm, or BFSI organisation preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage high volumes of candidates across multiple tracks simultaneously.
* Excellent stakeholder management — comfortable engaging with senior leadership as well as fresh graduate candidates.
* Hands\-on experience with an ATS or HRIS platform; Workday Recruiting exposure strongly preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
* Willingness to travel to campuses across Bengaluru and pan\-India during drive season (typically Oct–Feb).

**Preferred**

* Experience designing and running structured induction or onboarding programmes.
* Familiarity with proctored assessment platforms (HirePro / Careernet ecosystem is a strong plus).
* Experience with employer branding initiatives: pre\-placement talks, guest lectures, hackathons, or campus competitions.
* Exposure to People Analytics tools and cohort tracking / reporting.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in HR, Organisational Behaviour, or a related field.

**COMPETENCIES \& ATTRIBUTES**

**Competency**

**What We're Looking For**

**Program Management**


Ability to hold multiple workstreams — college relationships, drives, post\-offer, induction — simultaneously without dropping the ball.

**Candidate Empathy**


Understands that a 22\-year\-old fresh graduate's first employer experience will define their career. Takes that seriously.

**Stakeholder Influence**


Can brief a VP and a TPO in the same day, and adapt communication accordingly.

**Data Discipline**


Tracks everything. Pipeline, yield, POFU status, joining risk — always up\-to\-date and reportable.

**Bias for Ownership**


Does not wait to be asked. Spots a gap and fixes it. This program is theirs to run.

**Relationship Builder**


Invests in TPO relationships year\-round. Shows up even when there's no active hire.

**Brand Ambassador**


Represents BXRE and Blackstone with credibility, warmth, and professionalism on campus.

**WORKING AT BXRE — WHAT TO EXPECT**


This is a high\-visibility role in a lean, fast\-moving People team. You will work directly with the Global leadership team and have regular touchpoints with the HR Leadership and business unit heads. There is no bureaucracy between you and the decisions that matter.


Bengaluru is BXRE's GCC hub. The office is growing quickly across Finance, Technology, Legal, and HR functions. The Catalyst Program is a strategic priority for the organization — this is not a backfill hire; it is a founding role in a brand\-new function.


You will be supported by a campus execution vendor, and by the broader People team for system access, data, and reporting. But this program is yours to lead.

Get ready to make an impact, and together, let's revolutionize the way we deliver HR support. The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

title: Sr. HR & Admin Executive
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Job Title:** HR Executive

**Location:** Thane, Maharashtra, India

**Experience:** 3–5 Years

**Department:** Human Resources

**Reporting To:** Administrative Head

**ROLE PURPOSE**

We are looking for a proactive, organised, and detail\-oriented HR Executive to support end\-to\-end HR operations for our Thane office. The successful candidate will manage employee lifecycle processes, attendance and leave administration, payroll inputs, HR documentation, recruitment coordination, and employee queries while ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with company policies and applicable Indian labour requirements.

**1\. HR Operations and Employee Lifecycle**

· Manage and maintain employee records throughout the employee lifecycle, from joining through separation.

· Coordinate onboarding activities, including offer documentation, pre\-joining follow\-up, document collection, induction, employee\-file creation, and HRIS updates.

· Track probation periods and coordinate confirmation documentation with reporting managers.

· Process employee transfers, promotions, salary revisions, role changes, and other employment amendments.

· Coordinate exit formalities, including resignation acknowledgement, clearance coordination, exit interviews, recovery details, final\-settlement inputs, and issuance of relieving and experience letters.

· Maintain personnel files and digital HR records, ensuring all employee information is complete, current, and securely maintained.

**2\. Payroll, Attendance and Leave Administration**

· Prepare and validate monthly payroll inputs, including attendance, overtime, incentives or allowances, deductions, salary changes, reimbursements, leave without pay, joining and separation data, and statutory deductions.

· Coordinate with the payroll team or external payroll partner to ensure payroll inputs are submitted accurately and within defined timelines.

· Maintain attendance records, shift schedules, timesheets, overtime data, and regularisation requests through the attendance or HRMS platform.

· Administer annual leave, sick leave, casual leave, unpaid leave, and other leave categories in accordance with company policy.

· Monitor leave balances, resolve discrepancies, and provide employees and managers with timely support on attendance and leave\-related matters.

· Support preparation of final settlement data for departing employees, including outstanding leave, recoveries, and payroll adjustments.

**3\. HR Documentation and Compliance**

· Draft, issue, and maintain HR documentation, including offer letters, appointment letters, employment contracts, confirmation letters, increment letters, transfer letters, warning letters, salary certificates, NOCs, and experience or relieving letters.

· Maintain records related to employee identity, address, bank details, education, previous employment, statutory declarations, and other joining documentation.

· Support compliance\-related documentation, including records required under applicable labour laws, company policies, and internal audit requirements.

· Assist in maintaining statutory records and coordination relating to PF, ESIC, professional tax, gratuity, and other employment\-related obligations, as applicable.

· Ensure confidential handling of employee compensation, personal information, disciplinary matters, and HR records.

**4\. Recruitment and Joining Coordination**

· Support recruitment activities by scheduling interviews, coordinating with candidates and hiring managers, sharing interview details, and maintaining recruitment trackers.

· Communicate with selected candidates regarding offer documents, joining dates, required documentation, and pre\-employment formalities.

· Coordinate background\-verification documentation and follow up on pending candidate information, where applicable.

· Maintain accurate recruitment status reports, candidate databases, and onboarding trackers.

**5\. Employee Relations and Engagement**

· Serve as a first point of contact for routine employee queries relating to attendance, leave, payroll, HR policies, documentation, benefits, and employee records.

· Support the Administrative Head in addressing employee concerns, grievance documentation, disciplinary processes, and policy communication.

· Coordinate employee engagement activities, celebrations, internal communication, recognition initiatives, and welfare programmes.

· Assist with training coordination, including participant nominations, attendance records, feedback collection, and training documentation.

· Support the annual or periodic performance appraisal process by maintaining trackers, sending reminders, and coordinating documentation.

**6\. Reporting and HR Systems**

· Maintain accurate data in HRIS, attendance\-management, payroll, and recruitment\-tracking systems.

· Prepare monthly HR MIS and reports covering headcount, new joiners, exits, attendance, leave utilisation, overtime, attrition, recruitment status, and payroll\-related data.

· Reconcile HR, attendance, and payroll data before monthly cut\-off dates and proactively identify and resolve discrepancies.

· Use Excel to prepare employee reports, trackers, reconciliations, and management dashboards.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**

· Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related discipline.

· 3–5 years of experience in HR operations, HR generalist work, or employee lifecycle administration.

· Demonstrated experience preparing payroll inputs and managing attendance, leave, and employee documentation.

· Exposure to Indian payroll practices and employment\-related statutory processes, including PF, ESIC, professional tax, and gratuity, is preferred.

· Experience using HRMS, payroll, biometric attendance, or employee\-record management systems is desirable.

· Experience working in a fast\-paced, multi\-department environment will be an advantage.

**SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES**

· Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including formulas, filters, sorting, conditional formatting, lookup functions, pivot tables, and reconciliation.

· Strong attention to detail and accuracy, particularly in payroll, attendance, and employee\-data management.

· Good written and verbal communication skills in English; Hindi and Marathi communication skills will be an advantage.

· Ability to manage multiple HR deadlines, particularly monthly payroll and reporting cycles.

· Strong coordination and follow\-up skills with employees, managers, candidates, payroll teams, and external service providers.

· Professional maturity, discretion, and a high standard of confidentiality.

· Employee\-focused approach with the ability to resolve routine queries promptly and professionally.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

· Timely and error\-free submission of monthly payroll inputs.

· Accuracy and completeness of attendance, leave, HRIS, and employee\-file records.

· Timely completion of onboarding, confirmation, and exit formalities.

· Responsiveness and quality of resolution for employee HR queries.

· Timely issuance of employment letters and HR documentation.

· Accuracy and punctuality of monthly HR MIS and statutory\-support documentation.

· Compliance with document\-control, data\-privacy, and internal HR\-policy requirements.
