title: Credit Associate - MSME & Retail Lending
description:
**Location:** Pune \- Work from Office  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Working hours:** 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM  
**Experience required:** 2\-5 years  
**CTC:** Rs 4\.20 lakh to 7\.5 Lakh, depending on practical skills and experience  
**Reports to:** Head (Business Operations)

***Please check before applying***

Apply only if all the following are true:

* You have 2–5 years of relevant experience in credit, lending, banking, an NBFC, a CA firm, debt advisory or loan operations.
* You have prepared CMA data and financial projections independently.
* You can understand a profit and loss account, balance sheet, GST returns, bank statements and existing loan statements.
* You are comfortable doing both financial analysis and case coordination.
* You are willing to work from our Pune office, Monday to Saturday.
* You are comfortable with occasional visits to bank branches in Pune.

**Please do not apply if:**

* You are a fresher with no relevant practical experience.
* Your experience is only in sales, telecalling or lead generation.
* Your experience is limited to bookkeeping, GST filing or income\-tax\-return filing.
* You have never prepared or worked on CMA data or financial projections for complex projects.
* You are looking for a work\-from\-home or five\-day position.
* You want a purely desk\-based analyst role with no client, accountant or lender coordination.

**About Finansh:**

Finansh is a Pune\-based debt\-advisory, capital\-structuring and credit\-intelligence firm.

We work with individuals, MSMEs, promoters and renewable\-energy businesses. Our work includes working capital, term loans, machinery finance, property\-backed lending, HNI home loans and renewable\-energy project finance.

Business mandates generally begin at Rs 5 Crore, and Finansh works across a network of 18\+ lending institutions.

This is an in\-house position with direct exposure to the Founder and Head of Business Operations.

**About the Role:**

We need a Credit Associate who can understand a borrower’s financial position and also take responsibility for moving the case forward.

This is deliberately a mixed role:

* Approximately 45% credit analysis and preparation
* Approximately 40% case execution and coordination
* Approximately 15% post\-disbursement and compliance support

The exact mix will vary depending on the cases being handled.

***This role suits someone who wants to understand and own the complete lending process\-not only prepare spreadsheets or only follow up for documents.***

**What you will do:**

**Credit Analysis:**

* Analyse audited and provisional financial statements, income\-tax returns, GST returns, bank statements, existing loans, CIBIL/credit\-bureau reports and repayment history.
* Prepare CMA data, financial projections, cash\-flow statements and loan\-repayment calculations.
* Calculate and understand ratios such as current ratio, debt\-equity, TOL/TNW, DSCR and ISCR.
* Check whether information in financial statements, GST returns, bank statements and loan records is consistent.
* Identify important discrepancies or missing information before submitting a case to a lender.
* Prepare borrower summaries, initial credit notes and replies to lender queries.
* Assist in assessing working\-capital, term\-loan, machinery\-finance, property\-backed, renewable\-energy and complex self\-employed borrower cases.
* Maintain clear assumptions and supporting sources for financial models.

**Case Execution:**

* Own assigned cases from document collection through lender submission, sanction conditions and disbursement.
* Maintain clear document checklists, pending requirements, next steps and target dates.
* Coordinate with clients, accountants and lender representatives for documents and clarifications.
* Review files for completeness before internal review or lender submission.
* Track lender queries, approvals, sanction conditions, documentation and disbursement progress.
* Support interest\-payment follow\-ups, lender audits and other assigned post\-disbursement requirements.
* Visit Pune bank branches when a case requires proper coordination, clarification or compliance support.

***Routine courier and document\-delivery work is not the purpose of this position.***

Qualifications and Skills

* MBA Finance, M.Com, CA or CMA. (Preferred)
* Strong accounting and financial\-statement understanding.
* Practical Excel skills, including formulas, linked schedules and financial models.
* Ability to explain financial movements and credit issues clearly.
* Professional written and spoken English.

**Growth at Finansh:**

A strong Credit Associate can progress towards a Senior Credit Associate position and ownership of a defined case portfolio or lending vertical within approximately 18–24 months.

Progression depends on work quality, judgement, reliability and the ability to handle cases independently.

**Selection Process**

* Initial application screening.
* Shortlisted candidates will be invited for one office visit.
* The office visit will normally include:
* a. A practical exercise using sample financial and case information.b. Discussion of the candidate’s approach.c. Interviews with the Head of Business Operations and Founder.
* Reference and background checks will follow for the selected candidate.

**Please do not visit the Finansh office without a confirmed interview appointment. Walk\-in applications will not be considered.**

**How to Apply**

Submit your CV together with answers to all the following questions:

* How many years of relevant credit or lending experience do you have?
* How many CMA or financial\-projection assignments have you prepared?
* Did you prepare them independently or under supervision?
* Which loan products and borrower profiles have you handled?
* Have you coordinated any case from application through sanction or disbursement?
* Are you comfortable working from the Pune office, Monday to Saturday?
* Are you comfortable with occasional Pune branch visits?
* What are your current location, current CTC, expected CTC and notice period?

**Applications without answers to these questions may not be reviewed.**

title: Co-Founder and Medical Doctor (MBBS)
description:
About Mednevo

Mednevo is an early\-stage AI healthcare startup revolutionizing \*primary healthcare\* in India. We combine \*cutting\-edge AI technology\* with a genuine patient\-first approach to deliver accessible, personalized, and high\-quality care. Our platform integrates \*on\-demand virtual consultations, in\-home doctor visits, proactive wellness monitoring, and AI\-powered tools for interactive consultations, patient education, and personalized health insights.

We are particularly focused on making quality care — including pediatric care — more efficient, affordable, and scalable across urban and semi\-urban India. As a small, high\-impact team (2\-10 people), we move fast and solve real problems: reducing wait times, supporting clinical decisions with AI, improving outcomes for families and children, and building the future of intelligent healthcare delivery.

The Opportunity We are looking for a passionate Medical Doctor to join as a Co\-Founder. This is not a traditional clinical job — it is a founding leadership role where you will shape the clinical vision, build the product alongside AI engineers, and help scale a mission\-driven healthcare ecosystem. You will bring real\-world medical expertise (especially in pediatrics) to ensure our AI tools are clinically accurate, safe, empathetic, and truly useful for Indian families and doctors.

Key Responsibilities **⁠ ⁠**

**Clinical Leadership \& Product Vision: Co\-define the medical strategy and clinical pathways, with special focus on pediatric care, primary health, preventive wellness, and common childhood conditions.** ⁠ ⁠AI \+ Medicine Integration: Work closely with AI engineers to train, validate, and refine AI models for symptom assessment, triage, personalized advice, and decision support. Provide clinical oversight to ensure safety and accuracy. **⁠ ⁠**

**Patient Care Excellence: Lead or supervise virtual consultations and in\-home visits (initially hands\-on, later more strategic). Help design workflows that blend human empathy with AI efficiency.** ⁠ ⁠Product Development: Collaborate on building user\-friendly tools for doctors, patients, and parents — including pediatric growth tracking, vaccination reminders, developmental screening, and family health management. **⁠ ⁠**

**Regulatory \& Quality: Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations, data privacy (HIPAA\-like standards), and medical ethics in India.** ⁠ ⁠Growth \& Ecosystem Building: Support fundraising, partnerships with hospitals/clinics, go\-to\-market strategy, and expansion of our AI\-hospital ecosystem. Represent Mednevo at medical conferences and among the doctor community.

**⁠ ⁠Team \& Culture: Help build a high\-trust, innovative team culture that attracts top medical and tech talent. What We’re Looking For** ⁠ ⁠Medical Qualification: MBBS from a recognized institution (mandatory). MD/DNB Pediatrics (pursuing or completed) is a strong advantage. **⁠ ⁠**

**Experience: 0\-2 years post\-MBBS (including internships or residency). Fresh graduates or final\-year MD candidates with strong academic records and genuine interest in technology are encouraged to apply.** ⁠ ⁠Passion for AI \& Innovation: Curiosity or experience in digital health, telemedicine, or AI applications in medicine. No prior tech experience required — we value clinical insight and willingness to learn. **⁠** 

**⁠Pediatric Interest: Strong preference for candidates with exposure to or deep interest in pediatrics — child health, neonatology, developmental pediatrics, or family medicine.** ⁠ ⁠Founder Mindset: Entrepreneurial spirit, ownership attitude, resilience, and excitement about building something from the ground up. Ability to wear multiple hats in a fast\-paced startup. **⁠ ⁠Skills: Excellent communication (especially with patients/parents), empathy, basic tech\-savviness, and comfort working in a remote/hybrid setup.** ⁠ ⁠Location: Open to candidates in Tamil Nadu, Kerala, or willing to relocate/base in Chennai/Thiruvananthapuram. What We Offer

**⁠ ⁠Significant Equity: As a Co\-Founder, you will receive meaningful ownership in the company — your impact will directly translate into long\-term rewards.** ⁠ ⁠Competitive Compensation: Stipend during the early phase, transitioning to market\-competitive pay as we grow and secure funding. **⁠ ⁠**

**Learning \& Impact: Direct mentorship from the Founder \& CEO. Opportunity to shape AI tools that can impact thousands of patients, especially children and families.** ⁠ ⁠Flexible Work: Remote\-first with support for in\-person clinical or team activities. **⁠ ⁠**

**Growth: Be part of a mission\-driven team at the intersection of AI, pediatrics, and healthcare innovation in one of India’s fastest\-growing sectors. If you are a doctor who dreams of using your medical knowledge to build the next generation of intelligent healthcare — rather than just practicing in the traditional system — this is your chance to become a true Co\-Founder. We review applications on a rolling basis and respond to shortlisted candidates quickly.** 

**Mednevo – Making healthcare smarter, kinder, and more accessible for every Indian family.**

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

* 25% (Preferred)

title: Software Development Engineer I (Full-Stack & AI)
description:
**About the role:** 
 Aleph Digital Technologies builds AI\-native software for process industries: chemicals, pharmaceuticals, energy and water. Our platform lets process engineers analyse plant data, digitise engineering drawings, build and run simulations, and deploy monitoring pipelines, all through natural language.
 



  





 We are an early\-stage engineering team. You will work across both frontend and backend from your first week, alongside the engineers who built the platform. Expect direct and frequent feedback, and real ownership of your work early on.
 



  





 This is a junior, full\-stack role on our FastAPI backend and Next.js / TypeScript frontend, with a path into our LangChain and LangGraph agent stack as you build context.
 



  





**Working arrangement** 



* Remote, based in India. Engaged and paid locally through an employer\-of\-record arrangement.
* At least five hours of daily overlap with Singapore business hours (SGT, UTC\+8: India is 2\.5 hours behind).



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Translate scoped requirements into production\-ready features across our FastAPI backend and Next.js / TypeScript frontend.
* Build responsive UI components and pages using Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind and shadcn/ui, and manage client\-side data fetching with SWR.
* Start with bug fixes and service maintenance, progressing to larger delivery as you build context in the codebase.
* Implement role\-based access control across the platform, against an access\-control specification owned by our senior engineers.
* Implement the audit trail for privileged actions to a defined specification: building and consuming internal APIs, optimising for correctness, performance and security.
* Use AI coding assistants throughout the development lifecycle: scaffolding, code generation, test writing, code review: while retaining full ownership of the correctness and security of what ships.
* Critically review and validate AI\-generated code rather than accepting it at face value, catching issues in logic or security that automated generation can introduce.
* Contribute to implementation trade\-offs and edge\-case decisions within an architecture that has already been validated.
* Develop, maintain and optimise the services and integrations that power the platform.
* Take on work in our LangChain / LangGraph agent stack as you build experience with the codebase and our practices.



  





**Qualifications** 




  





**Minimum qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent demonstrable experience.
* Solid full\-stack fundamentals: hands\-on backend experience (Python and FastAPI a strong plus) and real frontend experience with React / Next.js and TypeScript.
* Comfortable debugging across the stack, from a UI symptom, through an API call, to the data layer.
* Regularly uses AI coding assistants as part of your own development workflow, and can describe a time you caught one producing wrong or unsafe code.
* Able to move from a rough idea to a working feature without a perfect spec, while flagging risks and edge cases along the way.
* Clear, direct communicator, comfortable working closely with a small team.
* Familiar with Git workflows and the software development lifecycle.



  





**Preferred qualifications** 



* Practical exposure to LLM application development: LangChain, LangGraph, prompt engineering, or building and consuming AI\-assisted features.
* Exposure to authentication and authorisation systems (RBAC, OAuth / OIDC, audit logging), including through coursework or a side project.
* Knowledge of Azure\-based authentication (Entra ID).
* Familiarity with workflow and orchestration tools such as Prefect, Airflow or Temporal.
* Interest in chemicals, pharmaceuticals, energy, water, or other industrial and regulated\-data domains.



  





**This role is not for** 



* Engineers who want to work on only one layer of the stack:frontend only, or backend only.
* People who need a complete, locked specification before they can start.
* Developers who ship a feature and disengage from what happens to it after launch.
* Candidates who are not comfortable using AI coding tools as a normal part of daily work.



  





**What to include in your application** 



* A link to your GitHub, or an equivalent public portfolio (add to your CV).
* Links to two or three projects you have built, school, personal or work, each with a one\-line note on which parts were yours (add to your CV).
* Public HackerRank, LeetCode, Codeforces or similar profiles, if you have them.



  





**Hiring Process** 



* Technical Round: Screening call and technical interview
* Team Fit: Casual conversation and cultural alignment



  





**How to apply** 




 Apply through LinkedIn. If you have questions about the role before applying, reach out to our hiring team.

MBA STUDY\-TO\-CORPORATE CAREER PROGRAM – 2026

JOB DESCRIPTION

Position: Online Project Trainee (PR)

Program Type: Part\-Time Online Job During MBA Studies

Eligible Students: MBA Second\-Year Students (3rd Semester)

“STUDY MBA. GAIN CORPORATE EXPERIENCE. BUILD YOUR CAREER.”

JV Financial and Investment Consultant Pvt. Ltd. invites applications from ambitious MBA students for its Online Project Trainee (PR) Program, a structured part\-time professional opportunity designed specifically for students who have successfully completed the first two semesters of MBA and are currently studying in the 3rd Semester / Second Year of MBA.

The objective of this initiative is simple but powerful:

To identify promising MBA students before graduation, provide them structured practical corporate exposure alongside their studies, develop their professional capabilities, and create a strong pipeline of trained talent for future roles at JV Financial.

Instead of waiting until MBA is completed to begin gaining professional experience, selected students will have an opportunity to start developing practical skills while continuing their regular MBA education.

WHY THIS OPPORTUNITY IS DIFFERENT

For many MBA students, the transition from classroom learning to corporate employment is one of the most important stages of their career.

JV Financial's Online Project Trainee (PR) Program is designed to help bridge this gap.

A selected student can simultaneously:

Continue MBA Education \+ Gain Practical Corporate Exposure \+ Earn ₹12,000 per Month \+ Build Professional Skills \+ Prepare for a Full\-Time Career Opportunity

The program is intended to provide students with meaningful exposure to professional communication, Public Relations, corporate research, business outreach, documentation, coordination and project\-based activities.

POSITION DETAILS

Designation: Online Project Trainee (PR)

Department: Public Relations / Corporate Projects

Employment Nature: Part\-Time during MBA studies

Work Mode: Online / Remote

Program Duration: Approximately one year / until completion of MBA, subject to the Company's program terms and performance requirements.

Monthly Compensation: ₹12,000/\-

The position has been specially structured for students who are continuing their MBA studies. Academic responsibilities remain important, and the program is intended to provide practical exposure alongside formal management education.

WHO CAN APPLY?

Applications are invited specifically from students who:

Are currently pursuing an MBA from a recognized university/institution.

Have successfully completed MBA Semester I and Semester II.

Are presently studying in MBA Semester III / Second Year.

Possess good written and verbal communication skills.

Have a genuine interest in Public Relations, Corporate Communication, Business Development, Marketing, Management or related corporate functions.

Are comfortable working through online communication and digital platforms.

Are willing to learn through practical projects and professional assignments.

Demonstrate discipline, professionalism, responsibility and commitment.

Have the ability to balance academic studies with structured professional assignments.

Students who have already completed their MBA are not the primary target group for this particular trainee program.

This opportunity has been designed specifically as a “During\-MBA Career Development Opportunity.”

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Selected Online Project Trainees (PR) may be assigned structured projects involving:

1\. Public Relations Support

Assisting the PR team in communication, outreach, coordination and relationship\-development activities.

2\. Corporate Research

Conducting basic research on companies, institutions, industries, markets and potential stakeholders as required for assigned projects.

3\. Institutional Coordination

Supporting professional communication with colleges, organizations, businesses and other institutional stakeholders.

4\. Business Communication

Assisting in preparation and coordination of professional emails, proposals, presentations, reports and communication materials.

5\. Digital PR Support

Supporting online PR campaigns, digital communication, content coordination and brand\-building activities.

6\. Project Coordination

Working on assigned corporate projects under the supervision of designated managers or project leaders.

7\. Database \& Reporting

Maintaining assigned project records, follow\-up data, activity reports and progress updates.

8\. Professional Relationship Building

Learning how professional relationships with institutional and corporate stakeholders are developed and maintained.

9\. Team Collaboration

Participating in online meetings, reviews, discussions and project coordination activities.

10\. Learning \& Development

Actively participating in Company\-led orientation, feedback, review and professional development activities associated with the trainee program.

WHAT WILL THE STUDENT LEARN?

The program is intended to develop practical competencies that complement an MBA curriculum, including:

Corporate Communication \| Public Relations \| Professional Networking \| Business Research \| Digital PR \| Institutional Communication \| Project Management \| Presentation Skills \| Reporting \| Team Coordination \| Professional Discipline \| Business Etiquette \| Corporate Exposure

The aim is to enable students to graduate not only with an MBA qualification, but also with meaningful exposure to professional work.

5\-STAGE ONLINE SELECTION PROCESS

To maintain the quality of the program, candidates will be selected through a structured five\-stage selection process.

ROUND 1 – ONLINE SCREENING

Evaluation of the candidate's academic profile, CV, communication ability, interests and suitability for the program.

ROUND 2 – WORK CAPACITY TEST

Executive / Coordinator – Founders' Office

**Location:** \[Location]  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years / Freshers can apply  
**Starting Salary:** ₹15,000 per month  
**Joining:** Immediate / 15 days preferred

About the Role

We are looking for a **smart, presentable and highly organised Executive / Coordinator – Founders' Office** to work directly with the founders and support them across different areas of the business.

This is an **entry\-level, multi\-functional role**. You will not be restricted to one department or one type of work. Depending on the priorities of the founders, your responsibilities may involve **HR coordination, administration, procurement, client coordination, email follow\-ups, documentation, research, software/product testing and other business activities**.

This role is ideal for a fresher or early\-career professional who wants to get **hands\-on exposure to how a company actually operates**.

What You Will Do

You will work closely with the founders and help coordinate day\-to\-day activities such as:

* Coordinating tasks and follow\-ups assigned by the founders.
* Communicating with employees, clients, vendors and other stakeholders.
* Supporting basic **HR activities**, employee coordination and documentation.
* Assisting with **office administration and operational activities**.
* Coordinating purchases, quotations, vendors and order\-related follow\-ups.
* Managing email communication, follow\-ups and maintaining important information.
* Coordinating client meetings, requirements and action items.
* Preparing basic reports, presentations, documents and trackers.
* Conducting online research and preparing information for the founders.
* Assisting with **software/product testing** and reporting issues clearly to the relevant team.
* Following up with different teams to ensure assigned work is completed on time.
* Helping with various projects and initiatives being driven by the founders.
* Taking ownership of other tasks assigned by the founders as business requirements change.

What We Are Looking For

**This is an entry\-level opportunity, so attitude and communication are more important than years of experience.**

We are looking for someone who is:

* A **fresher or has up to 2 years of experience**.
* Excellent in **spoken and written English**.
* Confident and comfortable communicating with different people.
* **Presentable, professional and well\-mannered.**
* Smart, alert and quick to understand instructions.
* Comfortable using computers, email and basic office applications.
* Good with **MS Office / Google Workspace**, especially Word, Excel/Sheets and PowerPoint.
* Organised and good at following up on tasks.
* Willing to learn different aspects of the business.
* Comfortable handling multiple types of work.
* Proactive and willing to take responsibility.
* Someone who doesn't say **“this is not my work”** when a reasonable business requirement comes up.
* Able to maintain confidentiality when dealing with information related to the founders and company.

Who Can Apply?

We welcome applications from:

* Fresh graduates
* BBA / B.Com / BCA / MBA graduates
* Graduates from other relevant disciplines
* Candidates with **0–2 years of experience** in coordination, administration, operations, HR, customer support or similar roles

Prior experience is **not mandatory** if you have the right communication skills, attitude and ability to learn.

This Role Is For You If...

You enjoy **variety rather than repetitive work**.

One day you may be coordinating with an employee, the next task could involve speaking with a client, checking a purchase requirement, preparing an Excel sheet, testing a software feature or researching something for the founders.

You should be comfortable with changing priorities and be someone who can simply take ownership and say:

**“I'll get it done.”**

Important Requirements

**Excellent English communication and a professional personality are mandatory.**

Candidates looking specifically for a narrowly defined **HR, Admin, Receptionist or Back\-office\-only role** may not be the right fit.

This is a **Founder’s Office role with exposure to multiple areas of the business**.

What You Will Gain

* Direct working exposure with the founders.
* Understanding of multiple functions of a growing business.
* Exposure to HR, operations, clients, procurement, technology and administration.
* Opportunity to develop strong communication, coordination and execution skills.
* Potential to grow into **Business Operations, Founder’s Office or a specialised functional role** based on performance.

**Starting Salary: ₹15,000/month**

If you are **articulate, presentable, eager to learn, organised and ready to take on different responsibilities**, this could be a great opportunity to start your career with direct exposure to the founders and the business.

Pay: From ₹15,000\.00 per month

title: Business Development Executive (BDE)
description:
**Job description:**  
Sales \& Business Development Executive

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **motivated, proactive, and result\-oriented Sales \& Business Development Executive** to join our team. The candidate will be responsible for generating new business opportunities, promoting our software products and IT services, managing client relationships, and converting qualified leads into successful customers.

The ideal candidate should have **excellent communication and interpersonal skills**, a strong business development mindset, and the ability to understand customer requirements and recommend suitable software solutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**  
**1\. Lead Generation \& New Business Development**

* Identify and generate new sales leads through multiple channels.
* Research potential customers, target industries, and new business opportunities.
* Build, manage, and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
* Conduct cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn outreach, networking, and other business development activities.
* Identify companies and businesses that can benefit from the company's software products and IT services.
* Qualify leads based on business requirements, budget, and potential.

**2\. Software Product \& IT Services Sales**

* Develop a strong understanding of the company's software products, features, benefits, pricing, and services.
* Conduct product presentations and demonstrations for prospective customers.
* Understand customer business requirements and recommend appropriate software solutions.
* Prepare quotations, proposals, and commercial documents in coordination with the management and technical team.
* Negotiate with prospects and work towards successful deal closure.
* Follow up consistently with prospects throughout the sales cycle.

**3\. Client Communication \& Follow\-ups**

* Communicate professionally and effectively with prospective and existing clients.
* Schedule product demonstrations, meetings, and business discussions.
* Maintain regular and timely follow\-ups with leads and prospects.
* Understand client concerns, requirements, and objections and provide appropriate solutions.
* Coordinate with the technical/project team whenever required to address client requirements.
* Maintain clear and professional communication throughout the sales process.

**4\. Business Development \& Market Expansion**

* Identify new markets, industries, and customer segments for business growth.
* Develop and implement strategies to increase software product and IT service sales.
* Build strong relationships with potential clients, business partners, and other stakeholders.
* Explore opportunities for recurring business, upselling, and cross\-selling.
* Monitor competitor offerings, pricing, and market trends.
* Identify emerging business opportunities and communicate them to management.

**5\. CRM \& Sales Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records of leads, prospects, meetings, follow\-ups, and sales activities.
* Keep the company's CRM and sales management system updated regularly.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports.
* Track leads and opportunities from initial contact through final conversion.
* Maintain proper documentation of client requirements, discussions, proposals, and follow\-ups.
* Ensure timely updates of sales pipeline and opportunity status.

**6\. Client Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain long\-term professional relationships with customers.
* Maintain regular communication with existing clients to understand their ongoing requirements.
* Identify opportunities for additional products, services, upgrades, and cross\-selling.
* Address client concerns professionally and coordinate internally to ensure timely resolution.
* Ensure a smooth handover of confirmed customers to the implementation/project team.
* Support the team in maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.

**Key Skills \& Competencies**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong sales, negotiation, and convincing abilities.
* Good understanding of business development and lead generation.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and present suitable software solutions.
* Strong follow\-up and relationship management skills.
* Proactive, target\-oriented, and self\-motivated approach.
* Good presentation and product demonstration skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with internal teams.
* Basic understanding of CRM tools, Microsoft Office/Google Workspace, and digital sales channels.
* Willingness to learn about new software products, technologies, and market trends.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in **Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, IT, Computer Science, or a related field**.
* Prior experience in **B2B sales, software sales, IT services, SaaS, or business development** will be an advantage.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and a genuine interest in sales and business development may also be considered.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Number of meetings and product demonstrations conducted.
* Sales pipeline growth.
* Lead\-to\-customer conversion rate.
* Revenue generated and sales targets achieved.
* Customer retention and repeat business.
* Upselling and cross\-selling opportunities.
* Accuracy and consistency of CRM and sales reporting.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work with software products and IT solutions.
* Exposure to B2B sales and business development.
* Learning and growth opportunities.
* Performance\-based incentives and career progression.
* Collaborative and professional work environment.

Job Summary

HiCentrix Placement Services is looking for a **dynamic, target\-oriented, and enthusiastic HR Recruiter** to join our recruitment team. The candidate will be responsible for sourcing, screening, interviewing, and coordinating candidates for various client requirements, especially **BPO, Customer Support, Sales, Telecalling, Back Office, and other non\-IT positions**.

* Understand client requirements and job descriptions before starting recruitment.

* Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Maintain a strong candidate database and talent pipeline.

* Conduct and coordinate walk\-in drives and recruitment campaigns.
* Negotiate salary and address candidate queries when required.
* Coordinate offer rollouts, documentation, and joining formalities.
* Ensure selected candidates join on the committed date.
* Maintain daily and monthly recruitment MIS and trackers.
* Achieve assigned **daily, weekly, and monthly hiring targets**.
* Maintain good relationships with candidates and clients.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment cycle.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong convincing and negotiation abilities.
* Good interpersonal and candidate\-handling skills.
* Knowledge of recruitment and sourcing techniques.
* Ability to work in a **target\-driven and fast\-paced environment**.
* Good follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Ability to handle multiple job requirements simultaneously.
* Basic knowledge of **MS Excel, Google Sheets, and recruitment portals**.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.

Educational Qualification

* Any Graduate / MBA / PGDM in HR or equivalent.
* Freshers with excellent communication skills and an interest in recruitment can apply.
* Prior experience in **BPO recruitment, bulk hiring, consultancy, or staffing** will be an added advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Daily and monthly candidate sourcing.
* Number of interviews scheduled.
* Number of profiles shortlisted.
* Positions closed within the required TAT.
* Offer\-to\-joining ratio.
* Candidate conversion ratio.
* Monthly joining targets.
* Candidate retention and follow\-up effectiveness.

What We Offer

* Performance\-based incentives.
* Recruitment and talent acquisition experience.
* Exposure to multiple industries and client requirements.
* Career growth opportunities.
* Training and mentoring.
* Dynamic and target\-oriented work environment.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

title: IT Support Analyst
description:
**About Bradken** 




 Bradken is a global leader in innovative wear solutions and custom\-engineered products for the resources sector. For our more than 3,000 people, that global reach creates opportunities to share expertise, solve meaningful challenges and grow through new experiences. Together, we help the resources sector sustainably advance society.
 



  





**About The Role** 




 Reliable enterprise systems are critical to keeping Bradken’s operations running efficiently. In this role, you will provide hands\-on support for Bradken’s ERP system and associated business applications, helping users resolve issues, maintain system performance and ensure business processes operate smoothly.
 



 Working across support, administration and continuous improvement activities, you’ll contribute to the reliability, security and ongoing enhancement of enterprise applications. Your work will directly support users across the business while helping improve system effectiveness and user experience.
 



  





**In This Role, You Will** 



* Provide first and second\-level support for ERP applications, investigating and resolving incidents and service requests within agreed service levels.
* Administer ERP user access, security settings and approved configuration changes to maintain secure and reliable system performance.
* Support business users through troubleshooting, guidance and training to improve system adoption and effective use of ERP applications.
* Assist with ERP testing, upgrades, patching and business change activities while minimising disruption to business operations.
* Monitor ERP jobs, interfaces and scheduled processes, escalating issues appropriately and coordinating with stakeholders and vendors to support resolution.
* Develop support documentation and knowledge articles while identifying opportunities to improve ERP processes, usability and support practices.



  





**What You’ll Bring** 



* Tertiary qualification in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* 2\-4 years' experience supporting enterprise business applications, preferably an ERP platform such as Epicor.
* Demonstrated experience investigating, troubleshooting and resolving application incidents and service requests in a production support environment.
* Experience administering ERP user access, security settings and system configuration changes.
* Experience supporting business processes through enterprise applications and assisting end users with issue resolution and system usage.
* Knowledge of IT service management practices, including incident, problem and change management.
* Experience supporting ERP testing, upgrades, patching activities or system enhancements.
* Experience creating and maintaining technical documentation, support procedures or knowledge articles.



**Please note:** 
 This role is based in Coimbatore. We are seeking applicants who are currently based in Coimbatore or are willing to relocate to Coimbatore at their own expense. Relocation assistance is not available for this position.
 



  





**Why join Bradken?** 




 At Bradken, you’ll do work that matters. Whatever your role, your contribution helps solve real challenges for our customers and supports safer, more efficient and more sustainable resource operations.
 



 You’ll join a team that values different perspectives, shares expertise and has the courage to challenge how things are done. We support your growth through hands\-on experience, learning and development, and opportunities to work across functions and locations. Safety, respect and wellbeing come first, so you can do your best work and enjoy life beyond it.
 



**We Offer** 



* A safety\-first culture
* Competitive pay and benefits
* Flexible work options, where the role allows
* Learning and development opportunities
* An Employee Assistance Program for you and your family



  





**Our hiring process** 




 As part of our selection process, we may invite you to complete a one\-way video screening at a time that works for you. This helps us provide a fair and consistent experience when working across locations and time zones. If you need an adjustment or an alternative format at any stage, please let us know.
 



  





 Before commencing employment, you will be required to complete a psychometric assessment and a pre\-employment medical, including drug and alcohol testing.
 



 We respectfully request no recruitment agency approaches.
 



  





 Bradken is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing a diverse, inclusive, engaging and flexible environment for our people. All employment decisions are based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
**GENERAL DIAGNOSTICS INTERNATIONAL (P) LTD.**

General Diagnostics (GD) is a new\-age medical technology company headquartered in Navi Mumbai, with regional laboratories across North and West India. Since its inception in 2008 by management graduates from IIT and IIM, GD has consistently driven innovation and developed breakthrough solutions in diagnostics.

Today, GD offers diagnostic services through franchise partners across 70\+ cities in India and has equity holdings and collaboration laboratories in five countries across Europe and Latin America. The organization comprises over 450 technicians, doctors, researchers, and business professionals, supported by a robust network of franchise partners nationwide.

GD is backed by one of India's most reputed healthcare\-focused private equity firms and is currently executing an ambitious nationwide expansion strategy.

**Pay:** ₹15,000\.00\-₹30,000\.00 per month

Job Description:

**Position \& Location**

**Designation:** Associate / Executive / Area Manager – Field Sales  
**Department:** Business Development  
**Location:** Supaul, Bihar (Supaul)

Qualification \& Experience

* Graduate or Postgraduate in any discipline.
* Experience in interacting with doctors, hospitals, clinics, or healthcare institutions will be an added advantage.
* Freshers with strong communication and interpersonal skills are encouraged to apply.

**Job Description**

General Diagnostics is hiring dynamic Field Sales professionals across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Kolkata, Pune, Ahmedabad, and multiple other cities across India. Candidates with experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical sales, diagnostics, or hospital relationship management will be preferred. Fresh graduates with strong communication and interpersonal skills are also encouraged to apply and will undergo structured training before taking on field responsibilities.

This role offers significant learning opportunities and rapid career progression as GD continues its expansion across India.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and develop prospective clients within the assigned territory, including hospitals, clinics, laboratories, and healthcare professionals.
* Conduct regular field visits and client meetings to promote GD's diagnostic services and solutions.
* Deliver effective sales presentations and communicate the value proposition of partnering with General Diagnostics.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
* Analyze market trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements to identify new business opportunities.
* Ensure achievement of assigned sales targets and business objectives.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of the company's products, services, and industry developments.
* Manage the complete sales cycle, including lead generation, client acquisition, onboarding, and lifecycle management.
* Prepare and submit periodic sales reports, market feedback, and business updates.

* Good written and verbal communication skills.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for people who are comfortable speaking with business owners, HR professionals, Accounts teams, retailers, institutions and other decision\-makers, understanding their requirements and introducing them to suitable software solutions.

* Freelance Sales Professional.
* Independent Business Associate.
* Customer Acquisition Specialist.

* HRMS \& Payroll Software.
* CRM \& Customer Management Software.
* Retail Billing / POS Software.
* Business Management Software.
* ERP / Factory Management Solutions.
* Fleet / Car Rental Management Software.

* New customer segments.

* Business associations and networking groups.

* H.R.M.S. / Payroll Software.
* Accounting / Billing Software.
* CRM Software.
* ERP Software.
* Digital Services.
* I.T. Products or Services.
* Banking / Financial Services.
* Business Consultancy.
* H.R. Consultancy.
* Accounting / Tax Consultancy.
* Insurance / Financial Product Sales.
* Telecom / B2B Product Sales.

However, **industry experience is not compulsory if you have genuine sales ability and a strong business network.**

Freelancer / Part\-Time Opportunity

This opportunity is also open to **freelancers, independent sales professionals and working professionals looking for additional income**.

If you already have:

* A strong business network.
* Existing relationships with business owners.
* H.R. / Accounts / Finance contacts.
* Retailer contacts.
* Corporate contacts.
* Local business associations.
* Professional networking connections.
* Experience selling software or business services.

you can work with us on a **performance\-based basis** without taking up a conventional full\-time job.

You can generate leads, introduce our products, arrange meetings and help close customers.

Full\-Time Opportunity

For suitable candidates joining on a full\-time basis, the role can include:

* Fixed remuneration.
* Performance\-based incentives.
* Sales targets.
* Additional incentives for achieving higher targets.
* Growth opportunities based on performance and contribution.

**Find → Approach → Understand → Demonstrate → Follow Up → Convert → Build Relationship → Generate Referrals**

may not be the right fit for this role.

A person who says:

title: Graduate Management Trainee (GMT) – Project Management & Operations
description:
Graduate Management Trainee – Project Management
 
**Location:** 
 Noida
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 Fresher / 0–1 year
 



**Company:** 
 Aereka Airtech Pvt. Ltd.
   




 About AEREKA
 
 AEREKA is building a next\-generation environmental technology platform focused on outdoor and semi\-outdoor air purification. We are developing a multidisciplinary deep\-tech product that brings together mechanical engineering, airflow and filtration, electronics, sensing, firmware, industrial design, data, AI, manufacturing, and real\-world deployment.
 



  





 We are looking for a
 **Graduate Management Trainee (GMT) – Project Management** 
 who wants to build a career at the intersection of
 **technology, engineering execution, product development, and business operations** 
 .
 



  





 This is not a conventional coordination\-only project management role. You will work closely with engineers, product teams, vendors, and leadership to help convert ambitious product goals into structured plans, measurable milestones, and executed outcomes.
   




 What You Will DoProject Planning \& Execution
 * Support end\-to\-end planning and execution of AEREKA's product development programs.
* Convert product and engineering goals into clear milestones, deliverables, timelines, owners, and review checkpoints.
* Track multiple engineering workstreams and ensure activities remain aligned with overall product milestones.
* Identify schedule risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and execution gaps before they become delays.
* Drive follow\-ups and closure of critical action items across teams.


 Cross\-Functional Engineering Coordination
 * Work closely with mechanical, electronics, firmware, testing, product design, AI/software, procurement, manufacturing, and other functions.
* Understand dependencies between different engineering workstreams and ensure teams receive the inputs they need at the right time.
* Act as an execution bridge between engineering teams, project leadership, vendors, and management.
* Support integration planning as individual subsystems move toward complete prototypes.



**You are not expected to be the technical expert in every discipline—but you are expected to understand the problem well enough to ask intelligent questions, identify dependencies, and drive execution.** 



 Project Monitoring \& Management Reporting
 * Maintain project plans, milestone trackers, action trackers, risk registers, and execution dashboards.
* Track planned versus actual progress and identify schedule deviations.
* Prepare concise daily, weekly, and milestone\-level management updates.
* Distinguish between activity and actual deliverable completion.
* Ensure project reviews are supported by evidence, clear ownership, and measurable next actions.
* Escalate critical blockers and decision requirements with clarity.


 Meetings, Decisions \& Action Closure
 * Participate in engineering, product, and management review meetings.
* Capture decisions, unresolved issues, dependencies, risks, and owner\-wise action items.
* Ensure important discussions are converted into executable next steps.
* Track actions through closure rather than allowing them to disappear after meetings.
* Help maintain visibility on pending decisions that could affect engineering timelines.


 Risk \& Dependency Management
 * Proactively identify technical, procurement, resource, integration, and schedule risks.
* Track cross\-functional dependencies and understand their downstream impact.
* Support teams in resolving blockers quickly.
* Maintain visibility on critical\-path activities and highlight potential timeline slips early.


 Product Development \& Operations
 * Gain exposure to the complete journey of building a deep\-tech hardware product—from concept and engineering validation to prototypes, testing, manufacturing, and deployment.
* Support prototype planning, procurement coordination, testing activities, vendor interactions, and build readiness.
* Help improve engineering execution systems, workflows, documentation practices, and review processes.
* Support the creation of scalable operating processes as AEREKA grows.


 Vendor \& External Partner Coordination
 * Coordinate with suppliers, fabricators, manufacturers, testing partners, consultants, and service providers.
* Track quotations, procurement dependencies, fabrication timelines, deliveries, and external commitments.
* Highlight vendor\-related risks that could affect project schedules.


 AI\-First Project Management
 
 We expect this role to use AI as an everyday productivity and execution tool.
 



 You will use tools such as
 **ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, and automation platforms** 
 to:
 


* accelerate project planning and documentation;
* convert meetings into structured decisions and action items;
* analyze project updates and identify execution risks;
* automate repetitive reporting and tracking activities;
* improve research and information synthesis;
* create management dashboards and decision\-support systems;
* improve personal and team productivity.



 We value people who can use AI to
 **improve the quality and speed of thinking and execution** 
 , not simply generate documents.
   




 Who Should ApplyEducational Background
 
**Preferred profile:** 



* MBA / PGDM in
 **Operations, Project Management, Strategy, General Management, Technology Management, or a related field** 
 ; and
* Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline such as:
* Mechanical Engineering
* Mechatronics
* Electronics \& Communication Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Instrumentation
* Robotics \& Automation
* Industrial / Manufacturing Engineering
* or another relevant engineering discipline.



**Experience:** 
 Fresh graduates or candidates with up to
 **1 year of relevant experience** 
 are welcome to apply.
 



 Exceptional candidates with a strong engineering background, excellent execution ability, and demonstrated interest in project/product management may also be considered.
   




 What We Look ForStructured Thinking
 
 You can take an ambiguous problem and convert it into clear tasks, priorities, owners, dependencies, and outcomes.
 


 Ownership
 
 You do not stop at "I followed up." You care about whether the required outcome was actually achieved.
 


 Technical Curiosity
 
 You enjoy understanding how products work and are comfortable interacting with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
 


 Analytical Ability
 
 You are comfortable working with project data, schedules, metrics, spreadsheets, dashboards, and structured analysis.
 


 Communication
 
 You can communicate clearly with engineers, managers, vendors, and leadership—and can summarize complex situations without unnecessary noise.
 


 Attention to Detail
 
 You can manage multiple moving parts without losing critical commitments, dependencies, or decisions.
 


 Bias for Action
 
 You identify what needs to happen next and actively drive it rather than waiting for repeated instructions.
 


 Learning Agility
 
 You can quickly learn unfamiliar technologies, engineering terminology, tools, and workflows.
 


 AI\-First Mindset
 
 You actively experiment with AI and automation tools to improve your own productivity and the productivity of the teams around you.
   




 What You Will Learn
 
 At AEREKA, you will get direct exposure to:
 


* Deep\-tech product development
* Hardware and multidisciplinary engineering programs
* Prototype development and validation
* Project and program management
* Product strategy and execution
* Manufacturing and vendor ecosystems
* Testing and engineering validation
* Cross\-functional leadership
* AI\-enabled project management
* Founder and leadership\-level decision making
* Taking a technology product from concept toward real\-world deployment



 This role is designed for someone who wants to develop into a
 **high\-ownership Project Manager, Program Manager, Product Operations leader, or technology business leader** 
 rather than remain limited to administrative project coordination.
   




 The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here
 
 You will enjoy this role if you:
 


* are deeply curious about technology and physical products;
* like bringing structure to complex situations;
* enjoy working with engineers but also understand business priorities;
* naturally follow problems through until they are closed;
* are comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment where not everything is predefined;
* can challenge unclear updates and ask good questions;
* learn quickly and take responsibility early;
* want a steep learning curve rather than a narrowly defined graduate role.



 AEREKA is building a product from the ground up. That means you will encounter ambiguity, changing priorities, engineering failures, difficult trade\-offs, and demanding execution timelines.
 



 For the right person, that is exactly what makes the opportunity valuable.
   




 Apply
 
 Apply through LinkedIn or send your resume to
 **sushil@aereka.com** 
 with the subject line:
 



**Application – Graduate Management Trainee (Project Management) – AEREKA**

You will work closely with the **content, social media, design, web development, and digital marketing teams** to improve search rankings, website performance, organic traffic, and overall online visibility.

* Develop and implement effective SEO strategies for multiple client websites.

* Perform complete **on\-page SEO optimization** for websites and landing pages.
* Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, image alt text, internal links, and website content.
* Conduct regular **technical SEO audits** and identify website issues affecting search performance.
* Monitor website indexing, crawling, broken links, redirects, canonical tags, sitemap, and robots.txt.

* Plan and execute effective **off\-page SEO and link\-building strategies**.
* Research and build relevant, high\-quality backlinks using ethical and sustainable SEO practices.
* Conduct competitor SEO analysis to identify keyword, content, backlink, and ranking opportunities.
* Create SEO content briefs and work with content writers to produce search\-friendly blogs and website content.

**Department:** Design / Engineering

We are looking for a skilled and detail\-oriented **Draughtsman** to prepare technical drawings, plans, layouts, and detailed designs as per project requirements. The candidate should have good knowledge of **AutoCAD and technical drawing standards** and should be able to coordinate with engineers, architects, site teams, and other departments.

The ideal candidate should be accurate, organized, technically skilled, and capable of handling drawings from initial concepts to final approved designs.

Key Roles \& Responsibilities1\. Drawing \& Design Work

* Prepare accurate **2D and 3D technical drawings** as per project requirements.
* Create detailed plans, elevations, sections, layouts, and working drawings.
* Prepare architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, or fabrication drawings as applicable to the project.
* Convert rough sketches, concepts, and instructions into professional technical drawings.
* Prepare detailed construction and execution drawings.
* Develop layouts and plans according to specifications and measurements.

2\. AutoCAD \& Software Work

* Create and modify drawings using **AutoCAD**.
* Prepare drawings using CAD software as per company standards.
* Update and revise drawings based on project changes.
* Maintain proper drawing layers, dimensions, scales, annotations, and symbols.
* Ensure all drawings follow technical and drafting standards.
* Work with other relevant design software when required.

3\. Site Coordination \& Measurements

* Visit project sites when required for measurements and verification.
* Take accurate site measurements and prepare drawings accordingly.
* Coordinate with site supervisors and engineers regarding drawing requirements.
* Compare site conditions with approved drawings.
* Update drawings based on actual site conditions.
* Resolve drawing\-related issues with the concerned team.

4\. Drawing Review \& Quality Control

* Check drawings for accuracy, completeness, and technical correctness.
* Verify dimensions, scales, specifications, and calculations.
* Identify errors or discrepancies before final submission.
* Ensure drawings comply with project requirements and applicable standards.
* Make corrections and revisions as instructed by engineers or management.

5\. Documentation \& Record Management

* Maintain proper records of all drawings and revisions.
* Organize approved, revised, and pending drawings.
* Maintain drawing registers and revision history.
* Prepare and submit drawings within the required timelines.
* Ensure the latest approved drawings are shared with the concerned departments.
* Maintain both soft and hard copies of important drawings.

6\. Coordination with Internal Teams

* Coordinate with engineers, architects, project managers, and site teams.
* Understand project requirements before preparing drawings.
* Attend meetings related to design and drawing requirements when necessary.
* Communicate drawing changes and revisions to the concerned teams.
* Support the project team with technical drawing\-related information.

7\. Material \& Quantity Support

* Assist in preparing material requirements based on drawings.
* Support the team in calculating dimensions and quantities.
* Prepare basic quantity take\-offs when required.
* Coordinate with procurement or site teams regarding drawing specifications.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of **AutoCAD**.
* Knowledge of 2D and preferably 3D drafting.
* Good understanding of technical drawings and drafting standards.
* Knowledge of dimensions, scales, layouts, and measurements.
* Ability to read and understand engineering and construction drawings.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple drawings and projects simultaneously.
* Knowledge of **MS Office**, especially Excel and Word.
* Knowledge of other software such as **Revit, SolidWorks, SketchUp, or similar software** will be an added advantage.

**Qualification**

* Diploma or Degree in **Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, Drafting, or a related field**.
* ITI or Diploma in Draughtsman trade may also be considered.
* Relevant certification in **AutoCAD** will be preferred.

**Experience**

* **1–5 years of experience** as a Draughtsman, CAD Draughtsman, or in a similar role.
* Freshers with strong AutoCAD knowledge may also be considered, depending on company requirements.

**Preferred Candidate**

**The ideal candidate should be:**

* Detail\-oriented and technically skilled.
* Proficient in AutoCAD.
* Capable of understanding technical requirements.
* Comfortable coordinating with site and engineering teams.
* Responsible for completing drawings within deadlines.
* Willing to visit sites when required.
* Able to work independently and as part of a team.

**Key Performance Areas**

* Accuracy of drawings.
* Timely completion of assigned drawings.
* Proper management of revisions.
* Compliance with project specifications.
* Coordination with internal and site teams.
* Quality and completeness of technical documentation.

description:

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a diverse team that feels they are valued in the workplace. So do you feel you do not meet every single requirement but still intrigued? We encourage you to still apply! You can help make our company even better. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, age, mental or physical ability, or any way you represent yourself. We strongly believe diversity makes for more successful teams. **Why Protolabs?**
We are the leaders in digital manufacturing. We hire doers, makers, and creative thinkers who tackle our roles with an entrepreneurial spirit. Our culture is centered around meaningful work that brings new and innovative products to market at unprecedented speeds. We are a diverse team that comes from all walks of life and take pride in our team who is smart, genuine, humble, and passionate about what we do. It’s our people who fuel our creativity and make our culture feel like home.**Join our team as a Talent Acquisition Sourcer!**
--------------------------------------------------


We are seeking a Talent Acquisition Sourcer to join our Global Talent Acquisition Center of Excellence (COE). This role will support our global hiring needs across all functions on the business. You will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and building strong pipelines of qualified talent across functions such as technology, engineering, and other corporate functions. You will work closely with the recruiters, hiring teams, and HR partners to develop sourcing strategies, conduct talent market research, and build diverse candidate pipelines to support current and future hiring needs globally.  


### **What You'll Do**


* Develop and execute proactive sourcing strategies to identify qualified candidates for career opportunities across multiple business and global regions.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs within technology (software, PMO, product, etc), engineering (manufacturing, quality, etc), and other corporate functions (finance, marketing, sales, HR, etc).
* Utilize a variety of sourcing channels, including LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, internal databases, professional networks, referrals, and industry associations.
* Conduct candidate outreach and engagement campaigns to generate interest.
* Perform candidate screening and qualification conversations to assess experience, skills, availability, and location alignment.
* Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to understand business requirements and talent market conditions.
* Conduct talent mapping and labor market research to provide insights on candidate availability, competitor activity, compensation trends, and geographic talent pools.
* Maintain accurate candidate records and activity within applicant tracking systems (ATS).
* Support diverse sourcing initiatives by identifying and engaging talent from a broad range of backgrounds and experiences
* Participate in workforce planning discussions and provide recommendations regarding sourcing strategies and talent availability.
* Ensure compliance with applicable employment laws, company policies, and recruitment best practices.

Build and maintain strong candidate relationships to enhance the overall candidate experience and employer brand.  
* 
### **What It Takes**

* Bachelor's degree required; professional certifications in HR or talent acquisition is a bonus
* 5\+ Years of experience in full\-cycle (End to End) recruitment.
* Sourcing experience in technology and engineering/operations required \- other business functions preferred \- with proven ability to engage candidates through creative sourcing techniques including LinkedIn, Social media, and other technical sourcing methods such as GitHub, Stack Overflow, and others.
* Proficiency in applicant tracking systems (ATS)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail
* Experience with Boolean search techniques and recruitment databases
* Strong organizational and time management capabilities
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively with a global team
* Professional demeanor with ability to handle confidential information
* Customer service mindset with capacity to work effectively across all organizational levels

* Coordinate with employees and internal stakeholders for HR\-related requirements.

* **SOPs \& Training :** Establish, implement, and document standard operating procedures (SOPs) for routine operations. Provide continuous training to in\-house teams and outside contractors to ensure absolute alignment.
* **SLA Enforcement :** Define clear facility service Level Agreements (SLAs) with performance targets. Track metrics systematically and firmly enforce compliance.
* **Employee Satisfaction :** Drives employee satisfaction by ensuring all facility service \& incident tickets are resolved thoroughly, tracked to proper closure, and communicated clearly to the team.
* **Asset Management :** Oversee all non\-IT assets across locations, ensuring rigorous tracking, regular lifecycle audits, and maintenance logs.
* **Lease \& Landlord Management :** Manage office space lease terms and landlord relationships for current properties in close coordination with the Finance team.
* **Space Evaluation :** Support the evaluation of new office space options at the direction of the executive team, including broker engagement, term sheets, LOIs, and basic financial analysis.
* **Fit\-Outs \& Build\-Outs :** Oversee office renovation and fit\-out projects from inception to completion. Hold primary contractors strictly accountable to budgets, quality standards, and timelines while coordinating key updates with the executive team.
* **Utilization Analytics :** Leverage data and dashboards to monitor and report key seat utilization metrics (available, utilized, billable, non\-billable, and cost per seat) to proactively optimize capacity.
* **Financial Acumen \& Budgeting :** Manage annual facility upkeep budgets. Identify and execute cost\-effective measures, vendor rationalization, and cost\-per\-seat benchmarking.
* **Automation :** Drive facility automation and smart building initiatives to reduce manual effort, optimize utility costs, and improve tracking efficiency.
* **Content Security Audits :** Ensure the company strictly adheres to stringent content security audits as they relate to physical security, access control, and visual barriers.
* **Safety \& Compliance :** Implement regular facility audits, risk assessments, and inspections to proactively identify compliance gaps and maintain general workplace safety.
* **Executive Reporting :** Provide regular, structural, data\-driven updates to executive management regarding costs, SLA performance, schedules, and project milestones.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**
-------------------

* **Bachelor’s degree** in Engineering, Management Studies, Business Administration, or a closely related field.
* **10\+ years of experience** related to facility management, corporate operations, or infrastructure support is highly preferred.
* Proven experience **managing facilities** across multiple geographic locations (exposure to creative studios or large corporate offices is an advantage).
* Commercial **real estate management** experience (negotiating leases, analyzing term sheets) is considered a strong plus.
* **Exceptional problem\-solving** skills; focuses on structural prevention over daily firefighting.
* Demonstrates high composure and **emotional intelligence** by remaining calm and objective under pressure, escalating issues structurally, and holding people accountable without friction.
* Patient yet fiercely **outcome\-focused** when developing internal teams and managing external partners.
* Highly **organized**, process\-driven, with a meticulous eye for detail in all administrative and operational workflows.
* Strong **financial acumen** to evaluate financial options, build business cases, analyze cost metrics, and negotiate hard with vendors.
* Exceptional written and verbal **communication skills**. Ability to interact professionally and persuasively with technical staff, external vendors, and C\-suite executives alike.
* **Tech Savvy** and highly adept at utilizing productivity tools (Google Sheets, Excel), project management platforms (Asana, Jira, or similar), and workflow automation software to track requests and maintain digital facility dashboards.

**Store Associate / Store Executive**

Company: **Crestview Adventure Hotel \& Resort Pvt. Ltd.**

Department: **Store**

Position: Store Associate / Store Executive

Reports To: Store Manager / Executive Chef / Purchase Manager / Accounts \& Finance, as applicable

Employment Type: Full\-Time

**1\. JOB PURPOSE**

The Store Associate / Store Executive is responsible for the receiving, checking, storing, issuing, recording, and maintaining all hotel and resort inventory in a systematic and controlled manner.

The position ensures that all materials required by different departments are available on time, properly stored, accurately recorded, and protected from damage, wastage, pilferage, or unauthorized use.

The Store Associate / Executive must maintain proper coordination with Purchase, Accounts, Kitchen, Food \& Beverage, Housekeeping, Engineering, Front Office, HR, and other operating departments to ensure smooth hotel operations.

**2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

A. **Receiving of Materials**

Receive all materials delivered to the hotel against approved Purchase Orders, Purchase Requisitions, and delivery documents.

Check the quantity, quality, specifications, brand, packaging, expiry date, and condition of received materials.

Verify received items against the Purchase Order and supplier invoice/challan.

Report any shortage, excess quantity, damaged goods, wrong items, or quality discrepancies immediately to the Store Manager/Purchase Department.

Ensure proper documentation of all inward materials.

Maintain the Goods Received Note (GRN) or applicable receiving records.

B. **Storage \& Inventory Management**

Arrange all materials in their designated storage locations in a clean, organized, and easily identifiable manner.

Follow proper FIFO (First In, First Out) and FEFO (First Expiry, First Out) methods wherever applicable.

Maintain proper segregation of food items, beverages, chemicals, housekeeping supplies, engineering materials, stationery, and other inventory.

Ensure appropriate storage conditions for temperature\-sensitive, perishable, fragile, and chemical items.

Monitor expiry dates and report near\-expiry or slow\-moving stock.

Ensure that storage areas remain clean, dry, hygienic, secure, and pest\-free.

Follow hotel safety, hygiene, and fire\-safety standards.

C. **Issuing of Materials**

Issue materials only against properly authorized Material Requisition / Store Requisition.

Verify the requesting department, item description, quantity, and authorization before issuing materials.

Record every issue accurately in the stock register/system.

Ensure that unauthorized persons do not collect or remove materials from the Store.

Maintain proper departmental issue records for audit and reconciliation purposes.

D. **Stock Control**

Maintain accurate physical and system stock records.

Conduct regular physical stock verification.

Assist in monthly, quarterly, and annual stock\-taking activities.

Identify discrepancies between physical stock and book/system stock.

Immediately report shortages, excess stock, damaged materials, or unexplained variances.

Maintain minimum and maximum stock levels as instructed by management.

Inform the Store Manager/Purchase Department when stock reaches the reorder level.

Monitor slow\-moving, non\-moving, excess, and obsolete inventory.

E. **Documentation \& Records**

Maintain and update relevant records, including:

Purchase Orders

Goods Received Notes (GRN)

Store Requisitions

Material Issue Records

Stock Registers

Bin Cards

Return/Replacement Records

Damage/Breakage Records

Expiry Records

Transfer Records

Physical Stock Verification Reports

Daily/Monthly Store Reports

Other records required by management

F. **Coordination with Departments**

Coordinate with all hotel departments regarding their material requirements.

Ensure timely availability of essential operating supplies.

Communicate stock shortages or expected delays to concerned departments.

Coordinate with Purchase regarding pending orders and replenishment requirements.

Coordinate with Accounts for invoice/document verification wherever required.

Support departmental stock audits and investigations.

G. **Quality, Hygiene \& Safety**

Ensure that no expired, damaged, contaminated, or unfit material is issued for operational use.

Maintain cleanliness and hygiene within all Store areas.

Follow proper handling procedures for chemicals and hazardous materials.

Ensure food and consumable items are stored according to applicable hygiene requirements.

Follow hotel fire, health, safety, and emergency procedures.

Report any unsafe condition, leakage, pest activity, damage, or security concern immediately.

H. **Security \& Loss Prevention**

Maintain strict control over Store access.

Prevent unauthorized removal, misuse, wastage, or pilferage of hotel materials.

Ensure proper documentation for all inward, outward, return, transfer, and disposal transactions.

Immediately report suspected theft, manipulation, or stock discrepancies to management.

**3\. DAILY DUTIES**

The Store Associate / Executive shall:

Check pending deliveries and expected materials.

Receive and inspect incoming materials.

Complete required receiving documentation.

Store materials in their designated locations.

Process authorized departmental requisitions.

Issue materials and update stock records.

Check critical stock levels.

Monitor expiry dates and perishable items.

Maintain cleanliness and organization of the Store.

Report shortages, damages, discrepancies, and unusual incidents to the reporting manager.

Complete required daily Store reports and handover.

**4\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

Accuracy of inventory records.

Stock availability and timely replenishment.

Reduction of wastage and stock losses.

Proper FIFO/FEFO implementation.

Accuracy of receiving and issuing procedures.

Physical stock vs. system/book stock reconciliation.

Timely completion of stock\-taking.

Proper documentation and record maintenance.

Compliance with hotel SOPs and audit requirements.

Cleanliness, hygiene, and organization of Store areas.

Prevention and reporting of pilferage/damage.

Coordination and service provided to operating departments.

**5\. AUTHORITY \& RESPONSIBILITY**

The Store Associate / Executive is responsible for maintaining proper control over materials entrusted to the Store.

The employee shall not:

Issue materials without proper authorization.

Alter stock records without approval.

Receive materials without proper verification.

Allow unauthorized persons access to Store areas.

Hide or ignore stock discrepancies.

Accept damaged/incorrect materials without reporting the issue.

Remove hotel property or materials for personal use.

Any suspected discrepancy, theft, damage, manipulation, or unauthorized transaction must be immediately reported to the concerned reporting manager.

**6\. QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCE**

Minimum Qualification:

Graduate / Diploma / relevant vocational qualification preferred.

Candidates with Hotel Management, Inventory Management, Supply Chain, or Store\-related education will be preferred.

***Experience***:

**1–3 years** of relevant experience in hotel/resort stores, inventory, warehouse, or material management preferred.

Freshers with suitable knowledge and attitude may be considered for the Associate level.

**7\. REQUIRED SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES**

Basic inventory and stock\-control knowledge.

Knowledge of FIFO/FEFO.

Basic computer skills.

MS Excel and inventory software knowledge preferred.

Good numerical and record\-keeping ability.

Attention to detail.

Good communication and coordination skills.

Ability to work under pressure.

Honesty and integrity.

Ability to maintain confidentiality.

Good organizational skills.

Ability to follow SOPs and management instructions.

Physically capable of handling routine Store operations.

**8\. BEHAVIOURAL EXPECTATIONS**

The employee is expected to:

Maintain punctuality and regular attendance.

Maintain professional conduct at all times.

Follow the hotel's rules, regulations, policies, and SOPs.

Maintain proper grooming and uniform standards.

Treat all colleagues and vendors respectfully.

Maintain confidentiality of company information.

Demonstrate honesty and accountability.

Take responsibility for assigned Store materials and records.

Cooperate with internal and external auditors.

Perform any other reasonable duties assigned by management in the interest of hotel operations.

**9\. WORKING CONDITIONS**

The position may require:

Working in shifts according to hotel operational requirements.

Working on weekends and public holidays as per duty roster.

Physical movement within Store and hotel operational areas.

Handling cartons, packages, supplies, and other materials.

Working in refrigerated/cold storage areas where applicable.

Supporting stock\-taking beyond normal operating hours when required.
