* **Collaborate with cross\-functional teams** 
 to understand data requirements, align on analytical solutions, and translate business problems into data science problems.
* **Read, understand, and extend existing codebases** 
 , adapting quickly to different coding styles and project structures.
* **Leverage version control tools like Git** 
 for collaborative development, code management, and maintaining reproducibility of models.
* **Write and optimize intermediate\-level SQL queries** 
 to extract, transform, and analyze data from structured databases.
* **Contribute to the deployment readiness of models** 
 , ensuring outputs are interpretable, reusable, and aligned with production or decision\-support use cases.
* **Document processes, assumptions, and outputs** 
 clearly for stakeholder transparency, reproducibility, and future reference.
* **Stay up to date** 
 with industry trends, new tools, and emerging best practices in data science, analytics, and development methodologies.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS** 




  




* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field (B. Tech / BE / Masters in CS/IS/AI/ML).



  





**Work Experience:** 




  




* Minimum of 3 years of hands\-on experience in a data science or analytics role, with a proven track record of building and deploying data\-driven solutions in real\-world scenarios.



  





**Technical Skills Required:** 




  




* Python Programming (Intermediate to Advanced): Strong grasp of syntax, data structures, and experience with libraries like pandas and numpy.
* Data Science Fundamentals: Ability to statistically validate features and models, ensuring sound analytical rigor.
* SQL (Intermediate): Proficiency in writing queries to extract, manipulate, and analyze data from relational databases.
* Version Control (GIT): Familiarity with collaborative development using Git for code versioning and management.
* Code Adaptability: Comfortable working with and modifying existing codebases written by others.



  





**Good to have skills:** 




  




* **Object\-Oriented Programming (OOPs) in Python:** 
 Understanding and applying OOP concepts where appropriate.
* **Test\-Driven Development (TDD):** 
 Awareness of TDD practices for faster iteration and improved code quality.
* **Model Deployment Lifecycle Knowledge:** 
 Familiarity with reproducibility, tracking, and maintaining deployed models (though not explicitly required, it’s a plus if known).

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Role \- Data Scientist 5\+ years** 




**Mandatory** 
 :
 **2–3 years of experience working on Short\-Term Personal Loan (STPL) products** 




**Location \- Mumbai Andheri (Full\-Time)** 




  





**About the company**




 We are a listed NBFC (BSE \& NSE) with \~40 years of history. Alongside a co\-lending / fintech partner book, we run — our own B2C short\-term personal loan (STPL) product launched in late 2025\. Ticket sizes are ₹1,000–₹15,000, and tenures are 3–6 months. We are a team (\~35–40 people) operating like a startup inside a regulated public listed NBFC.
 



  





 The Data Science team owns Risk, policy, fraud signals, scorecards, and portfolio \& overall analytics. We are hiring a
 **Senior Data Scientist** 
 who has built and shipped credit decisioning systems (scorecards, BRE, feature pipelines) in digital lending.
 



  





**The Role**




 Own end\-to\-end credit \& fraud data science : feature engineering from raw bureau JSON ,SMS,DEVICE, scorecard / model development, Business Rule Engine (BRE) design, monitoring, and partnering with product/engineering to put rules live. You will work directly with the existing DS team, tech, product and founders — decisions are data\-backed and debated.
 



  





**What you will own**




  





 1\. Build and maintain credit scorecards and models for FTB and Repeat Borrowers (Xgboost, Random forest, Support Vector Machine Models, ensemble models, challenger models).
 



 2\. Engineer features from raw CRIF (or equivalent) bureau JSON — tradelines, enquiries, DPD
 



 histories, identity matches — and from raw SMS / FinBox alt\-data (collections, rejections, salary, app footprint).
 



 3\. Design, validate, and ship Models: hard rejects, soft flags, amount caps — with clear lift/capture / approval trade\-offs.
 



 4\. Own portfolio risk analytics: vintage / DPD / non\-starter / POS bad\-rate monitoring; propose tier pauses, cool\-offs, and ladder\-up changes.
 



 5\. Build fraud signals (device, SIM/OTP, mule, ring, post\-disbursal disappearance) and help prioritise the fraud PRD backlog into production.
 



 6\. Partner with engineering to productionise features, rules, and models (Watchtower\-style shadow
 



 underwriting, policy index, monitoring dashboards).
 



 7\. Challenge and refine existing tier/ladder policy with evidence; communicate clearly to founders and business.
 



  





**Required experience**




  





 ● Tenure: 5\+ years overall experience in data science/analytics.
 



 ● Digital lending: Minimum 3 years hands\-on in digital lending/consumer credit (NBFC, fintech lender, digital/STPL) who has built models themselves.
 



 ● Scorecards/models: Built and deployed at least one credit scorecard (first\-time borrower or repeat borrower, or combined model) into a live BRE / LOS. Should improve approval–bad\-rate trade\-offs from production experience.
 



 ● Bureau: Parsed and engineered features from raw bureau files (CRIF / CIBIL / Experian JSON or
 



 XML) — not only vendor\-precomputed attributes.
 



 ● Non\-starter models: Fraud/non\-starter / First Payment default modelling experience in
 



 short\-tenure lending.
 



 ● Limit Assignment: Experience with repeat\-borrower ladder / limit\-management policies.
 



 ● Monitoring and QC: Shadow underwriting/champion–challenger frameworks.
 



 ● Alt\-data: Worked with SMS / alt\-data / device / AA signals for underwriting or fraud (FinBox, similar vendors, or in\-house SMS parsing).
 



 ● Stack: Strong SQL \+ Python (pandas, sklearn/Logistic / lightgbm/Xgboost/randomforest,
 



 statsmodels). Able to write production\-quality notebooks and scripts, not just slide decks.
 



 ● Communication: Comfortable debating policy with founders/credit heads using data; owns the "show me the evidence" conversation.
 



  





**Nice to have**
 :
 



  





 ● Feature stores, Airflow/cron pipelines, S3 \+ Postgres \+ DynamoDB.
 



 ● Prior Experience: Prior work at a zero\-to\-one digital lender or STPL product.
 



  





**What success looks like in 6 months**




  





 ● A documented feature dictionary from raw bureau \+ SMS with IV/KS ranking.
 



 ● At least one new scorecard/model live with clear expected vs observed bad\-rate impact.
 



 ● Non\-starter / First Payment Defaults monitoring with actionable rule recommendations and clear
 



 demonstrated improvements in defaults
 



 ● Credible pushback on weak policy ideas — backed by analysis, not opinion.
 



  





**Hiring process**




  





 1\. Screening call and technical deep dive (role fit, digital lending depth).
 



 2\. In\-person technical deep dive \+ case study \+ portfolio discussion \+ overall
 



 3\. Founder/culture \+ Technical round.
 



 4\. Offer.

Veeva Systems is a mission\-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
   

  

 At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
   

  

 Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 Do you dream about being part of a team with the talent, passion, and financial backing to build top\-notch, industry\-changing cloud\-based applications and platforms? At Veeva, we build enterprise cloud technology that powers the biggest names in pharmaceuticals, biotech, consumer goods, chemical \& cosmetics industries. Our customers make vaccines, life\-saving medicines, and life\-enhancing products that make a difference in everyday lives. Our technology has transformed these industries, enabling them to get critical products and services to market faster. Our products empower our customers in the fight against global pandemics like COVID\-19\.
   

  

 Veeva Systems is expanding its global footprint with a new development centre in Hyderabad, India. This emerging and growing branch of Veeva is looking for Software Engineer, Test Automation for multiple positions to expand global quality \& release engineering efforts. You will be working on cutting\-edge technologies such as Cucumber, AWS(EC2, S3, Workspace), Visual Regression \& DevOps Tools, playing a pivotal role in developing/maintaining automating tests to support our ever\-growing suite of regression tests. The ideal candidate will be highly technical, motivated, and can work without too much supervision.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Learn and understand the features of the Veeva Vault platform and applications
* Perform automation feasibility analysis of assigned test cases
* Develop and maintain automation scripts (API and UI)
* Work on CI/CD tools (Git, Jenkins, JIRA) on a daily basis
* Communicating status and working with onshore managers and team leads


**Requirements**
* 1\+ years of experience in software test automation
* Strong knowledge of Java, Object\-Oriented Methodologies
* Knowledge of Agile/Scrum development methodologies (preferably in an onshore /offshore model)
* Effective communication skills
* Bachelor’s in Mathematics or Computer Science/Applications or a similar field


****Nice to Have****
* Familiar with automated UI test frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cucumber)
* Experience working in the life sciences and healthcare industry
* Experience working for a product\-based company
* Participation in code hackathons and other open\-source community activities
* Good working knowledge of CI/CD tools (Git, Jenkins, JIRA).


**Perks \& Benefits**
* Health insurance with generous coverage limits
* Fixed cash bonus
* Allowance for wellness \& fitness programs
* Winter break


 Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
   

  

 Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
**Job Description:**
**QA Automation Engineer**
**Internal Job Description**
**Level:** 
 30
   

  

**Location:** 
 Dentsu India
   

  

**Team:** 
 Digital Product, Pipes
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The QA Automation Engineer sits within the Digital Product team responsible for building
 **Pipes** 
 , Dentsu’s global advertising QA product used across markets to ensure media accuracy and operational excellence.
   

  

 This role will focus on
 **improving, expanding, and maintaining automated test coverage** 
 across the Pipes platform. The QA Automation Engineer will work across
 **three engineering squads** 
 , partnering with developers and product managers to ensure we deliver stable, high‑quality functionality at speed.
   

  

 This is a
 **technical automation role** 
 , not a manual QA / test analyst position. The engineer will be responsible for writing automated tests, maintaining our testing frameworks, and contributing to a robust CI pipeline.
   

  

 Given the level, the role is expected to work with guidance from senior engineers, while gradually taking ownership of the test automation suite. They will be working alongside and as part of the development team, and have a great deal of autonomy to influence the development team’s testing processes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Test Automation \& Technical Delivery**
* Develop, improve, and maintain automated test suites across frontend and backend components.
* Write high‑quality, maintainable automated tests that support rapid delivery and reliability.
* Identify and implement a test coverage tool to monitor coverage.
* Own the execution and reporting of automated test pipelines within CI/CD workflows.
* Monitor test flakiness and stability; proactively diagnose root causes and implement fixes.
* Contribute to discussions on testing strategy, tooling, and testability improvements across the product.
* Ensure all automated testing follows best practice, is version‑controlled, and integrates cleanly into engineering workflows.
* Design and implement E2E testing to simulate real user actions and validate the full workflow.


**Collaboration \& Ways of Working**
* Work day‑to‑day with developers across three squads to embed quality into feature development.
* Participate in squad ceremonies (stand‑ups, refinement, planning), providing input on test impact and automation needs.
* Collaborate with product managers and engineering leads to understand feature requirements and identify test scenarios.
* Work within an agile, cloud‑first engineering environment and contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes.
* Document and track bugs encountered, providing detailed reproduction steps, environment details and visual documentation to facilitate efficient resolution.


**Learning \& Growth**
* Learn from developers to deepen technical skills.
* Stay current with modern test automation frameworks, patterns, and tools, recommending improvements where valuable.
* Contribute to documentation of test suites, frameworks, and best practices.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* 1–3 years’ experience in QA automation or software engineering roles with a testing focus.
* Experience developing automated tests for web applications (frontend or backend).
* Familiarity with at least one E2E / Browser Automation framework (e.g., Cypress, Playwright, Selenium) and one Unit Framework (xUnit, Jest, NUnit).
* Ability to read and write code in at least one programming language (JavaScript/TypeScript, C\#, Python, or similar).
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution.
* Ability to work within an agile engineering environment.


**Desirable / Nice\-to\-Have Skills**
 Experience with some of the following is beneficial but
 **not required** 
 :
   

  

**Backend Testing**
* xUnit or similar unit testing frameworks for .NET environments.
* API / integration testing methods and tools.


**Frontend Testing**
* Cypress, Playwright, or similar browser automation tools. (We currently use Cypress but are open to modernising our approach.)


**General Technical Experience**
* Git and version control workflows.
* Dockerised development/testing environments.
* Cloud platforms (Google Cloud Platform preferred but not essential).


**Tech Environment (for Context)**
 The Pipes product is built using:
   

  

**Backend:** 
 C\# (.NET)
   

  

**Frontend:** 
 ReactJS
   

  

**Data:** 
 MySQL, Firestore, BigQuery
   

  

**Infrastructure:** 
 Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud Scheduler, Docker)
   

  

**Testing Frameworks (Current \& Planned):**
* xUnit (C\#)
* Cypress (legacy, under review)
* Potential introduction of Playwright or similar end\-to\-end test automation tool.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Within 6\-12 months, success in this role will include:
   

  

* Demonstrably higher automated test coverage across the platform.
* Stable, reliable automated pipelines with decreased test flakiness.
* Ability to work independently across squads and manage the testing suite.
* Meaningful contribution to the team’s confidence in software quality and release reliability.


**Location:**
 DGS India \- Bengaluru \- Manyata N1 Block
   

  

**Brand:**
 Merkle
   

  

**Time Type:**
 Full time
   

  

**Contract Type:**
 Permanent\#DGS

title: Apprentice
description:
****Who We Are Looking For****

You’ll learn from some of the most respected highly qualified people in the industry and be supported by individual mentors and development programs.

We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence, and robotics process automation. We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end\-to\-end, next\-generation financial services company.
   

  

 Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems, and make your mark on our industry.
   

  

****What You Will Be Responsible For****

* Analyzing the business/ technical requirement documents
* Contributing to the application design, development, testing and deployment
* Participating in agile team meetings such as Stand\-up calls and retrospective meetings
* Preparing the technical documentation required for adopted SDLC process.
* Collaborating with various State Street internal teams
* Develop and maintain applications with Java and SQL.
* Functional Testing, Database SQL, Manual TestingReactJS/AngularJS with node
* Presentation Skill, Excel Reporting/PowerBI/Tableau, Communication skill, SharePoint, Power Automate

* Support the ‘Risk Excellence’ culture within the business.

****Education \& Preferred Qualifications****
* B.Tech/M.Tech/MCA degree or equivalent or related field

* Good understanding of SQL performance tuning techniques including query plan understanding and management, SQL tracing, DB stats, indexing techniques etc., highly preferred
* Good in managing and resolving problems on a live production system.
* Candidates must be fresher and available to work on a full\-time basis from Sept 2025\.


****About State Street****
**What we do.** 
 State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data \& analytics, investment research \& trading and investment management to institutional clients.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Meet The Team**
 A software engineer specializing in wireless technology at Cisco is responsible for driving the design, implementation, and optimization of wireless solutions for customer projects and accounts. This role requires a deep understanding of current and emerging wireless standards, including Wi\-Fi 8 (IEEE 802\.11bn / Ultra High Reliability), 802\.1X security types, and Layer 2 protocols. The engineer will leverage AI/ML knowledge to uplift test automation, develop new test plans, and build productivity\-enhancing tools, ensuring superior wireless network reliability, latency, performance, and customer outcomes.
   

  

**In This Role**
* Lead technology design, planning, and deployment of wireless solutions, including small to mid\-size or moderately complex systems, ensuring reliability, availability, latency, resilience, and performance targets are met across current\-generation and emerging Wi\-Fi 8 environments.
* Collaborate with customers to plan, design, configure, and validate Cisco wireless technologies, including Wi\-Fi standards through Wi\-Fi 8 (IEEE 802\.11bn), Layer 2 protocols, WLAN technologies, and 802\.1X security types.
* Write new test automation scripts and uplift existing test scripts using Python to enhance wireless technology testing frameworks and improve automation efficiency.
* Utilize AI/ML techniques to uplift test automation frameworks, develop new test plans tailored to wireless and Wi\-Fi 8 reliability requirements, and build tools that improve productivity and streamline testing and deployment processes.
* Assist with integration and implementation of tools, systems, and service assurance related to wireless networks, including continuous monitoring, telemetry analysis, and alerting in test and production environments for latency, packet loss, roaming, interference, and reliability conditions.
* Support presales by translating business requirements into technical wireless solution designs and creating customer collateral, documentation, and knowledge transfer materials.
* Drive customer technology transitions and influence solution architectures and services in wireless networking, including readiness planning for Wi\-Fi 8 and Ultra High Reliability capabilities.
* Comply with company policies and utilize relevant tools to support Professional Services strategies and goals.
* Act as an individual contributor and mentor within the team, providing guidance and support to peers and engineering interns.
* Lead corrective actions, including root cause analysis and process improvements on escaped defects for specific product features.
* Implement automation frameworks and execute test cases and plans for projects with multiple features, including Wi\-Fi 8 functional, interoperability, performance, reliability, and regression validation.
* Report issues and findings with root cause analysis and potential software solutions; advocate for quality improvements and strategic changes.
* Oversee creation and storage of test plans and documentation; translate dashboard metrics into consumable documentation such as release notes, bug reports, and test results.
* Collaborate with other engineering groups to document test cases and apply best practices for document review.
* Develop productive working relationships with peer stakeholders within and across teams.
* Work independently with guidance from leadership to determine the best approach to accomplish work and act as a resource for less experienced colleagues.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Deep domain\-based engineering and configuration knowledge of Cisco wireless technologies, with knowledge of current Wi\-Fi generations and emerging Wi\-Fi 8 (IEEE 802\.11bn) concepts.
* Working knowledge of Wi\-Fi standards, including Ultra High Reliability objectives, deterministic and tail\-latency behavior, packet\-loss reduction, roaming continuity, overlapping\-BSS performance, multi\-AP coordination concepts, coexistence, and backward compatibility.
* Strong expertise in AI/ML applications for test automation and productivity improvements.
* Experience in writing comprehensive test plans and building automation tools for wireless functional, interoperability, roaming, latency, packet\-loss, reliability, and performance validation.
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills specific to wireless networks, including interference, congestion, roaming, latency, packet loss, and multi\-AP deployment scenarios.
* Excellent communication and customer engagement abilities.
* Experience in solution design activities.
* Ability to create and deliver technical documentation and training materials.


**Key Technologies**
* Wi\-Fi Standards: Knowledge of Wi\-Fi generations, including Wi\-Fi 6/6E, Wi\-Fi 7, and emerging Wi\-Fi 8 (IEEE 802\.11bn / Ultra High Reliability). Understanding the evolution of these standards and their security, reliability, latency, power\-efficiency, coexistence, and performance objectives is essential.
* Wi\-Fi 8 / IEEE 802\.11bn: Familiarity with the emerging Ultra High Reliability amendment and its focus on WLAN reliability, latency, throughput, roaming continuity, power efficiency, peer\-to\-peer operation, coexistence, and overlapping\-BSS performance.
* Layer 2 Protocols: Familiarity with Layer 2 security policies such as WLAN, Static WEP, WPA/WPA2, WPA3, and especially 802\.1X authentication. Knowledge of encryption types like TKIP, AES, CCMP, and GCMP is important.
* WLAN Technologies: Expertise in Cisco wireless solutions, including configuration of WLAN security, use of Cisco Wireless LAN Controllers, and deployment of secure WLANs with features such as Fast Secure Roaming (802\.11r), AAA integration with RADIUS and Cisco ISE, multi\-AP architectures, and telemetry\-driven assurance. Familiarity with Wi\-Fi 8 goals for improved reliability, latency, roaming resilience, and operation across overlapping BSS environments is desirable.
* 802\.1X Security Types: Deep understanding of 802\.1X authentication mechanisms including EAP types such as PEAP, EAP\-TLS, LEAP, and EAP\-FAST. Knowledge of how 802\.1X integrates with AAA servers (e.g., Cisco ISE) for centralized policy management, and how it supports secure network access and segmentation.
* Python programming for developing and uplifting test automation scripts, enhancing wireless technology testing frameworks and productivity.
* AI/ML Knowledge: Proficiency in applying Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to improve wireless performance and operational efficiency. The role includes uplifting test automation, generating wireless test plans, building productivity tools, and validating Wi\-Fi 8 reliability objectives.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Software Engineer, Ray Core
description:
**About Anyscale**
 At Anyscale, we're on a mission to democratize distributed computing and make it accessible to software developers of all skill levels. We’re commercializing Ray, a popular open\-source project that's creating an ecosystem of libraries for scalable machine learning. Companies like OpenAI, Uber, Spotify, Instacart, Cruise, and many more, have Ray in their tech stacks to accelerate the progress of AI applications out into the real world.
   

  

 With Anyscale, we’re building the best place to run Ray, so that any developer or data scientist can scale an ML application from their laptop to the cluster without needing to be a distributed systems expert.
   

  

 Proud to be backed by Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, and Addition with $250\+ million raised to date.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Ray aims to provide a universal API for building distributed applications. To achieve this goal requires a distributed system with high levels of performance and reliability. We're looking for engineers with systems software experience that are interested in contributing to the Ray backend.
   

  

**About The Ray Core Team**
 The Ray Core team develops and maintains the Ray C\+\+ backend (e.g., distributed scheduler, language runtime integration, I/O and memory subsystems). We are responsible for the reliability, scalability, and performance of Ray as well as ensuring that Ray provides the right feature set to support higher level libraries and use cases. The team works on a balance of new features / distributed libraries, test infra improvements, debugging, and longer\-term architectural improvements to Ray.
   

  

**A Snapshot Of Projects You Can Work On**
* Optimizing performance of large\-scale workloads on Ray
* Stability and stress testing infrastructure
* Improving fault tolerance (HA)


**As Part Of This Role, You Will**
* Develop high quality open source software to simplify distributed programming (Ray)
* Identify, implement, and evaluate architectural improvements to Ray core
* Improve the testing process for Ray to make releases as smooth as possible
* Communicate your work to a broader audience through talks, tutorials, and blog posts


**We'd Love To Hear From You If Have**
* At least 2 year of relevant work experience
* Solid background in algorithms, data structures, system design
* Experience in building scalable and fault\-tolerant distributed systems
* Knowledge of distributed model training and inference (e.g. tensor parallel, pipeline parallel) is preferred
* Knowledge of GPU programming is preferred

description:

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 The Security Managed Services Engineer (L1\) is an entry level engineering role, responsible for providing a managed service to clients to ensure that their Firewall infrastructure remain operational through proactively identifying, investigating, and routing the incidents to correct resolver group.
   

  

 The primary objective of this role is to ensure zero missed service level agreement (SLA) conditions and focuses on first\-line support for standard and low complexity incidents and service requests.
   

  

 The Security Managed Services Engineer (L1\) may also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**What you'll be doing**
 SOC Analyst
   

  

 Configure and maintain the SIEM system, ensuring that it's properly set up to collect and analyze security event data. Develop, customize, and manage security rules within the SIEM to detect and respond to security threats. Monitor SIEM alerts, investigate them, and take appropriate actions based on the severity and nature of the alerts. Oversee the collection, normalization, and storage of log data from various sources.
   

  

 Develop and document incident response procedures, and lead or assist in incident response efforts when security incidents occur. Analyze and investigate security events from various sources. Manage security incidents through all incident response phases to closure. Utilize SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, EDR, NBAD,Splunk
   

  

 PCAP, Vulnerability Scanning, and Malware analysis technologies for event detection and analysis.
   

  

 Update tickets, write incident reports, and document actions to reduce false positives. Develop knowledge of attack types and finetune detective capabilities.
   

  

 Identify log sources and examine system logs to reconstruct event histories using forensic techniques.
   

  

 Align SIEM rules and alerts with the LIC’s security policies and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Conduct computer forensic investigations, including examining running processes, identifying network connections, and disk imaging.
   

  

 Maintain and support the operational integrity of SOC toolsets.
   

  

 Collaborate with SIEM solution vendors for updates, patches, and support to ensure the system's reliability and effectiveness.
   

  

 Maintain thorough documentation of the SIEM system's configuration, procedures, and incident response plans.
   

  

 Proactively identify and report system security loopholes, infringements, and vulnerabilities to the Security Operations Centre Manager in a timely manner.
   

  

 Work closely with other IT and security teams during incident response, coordinating efforts and sharing information to mitigate security incidents effectively.
   

  

 Ensure that the SIEM system helps the LIC meet regulatory compliance requirements and is ready for security audits.
   

  

 Continuously optimize the SIEM system for efficient performance, ensuring it can handle the volume of data and remain responsive.
   

  

 Develop automation scripts and workflows to streamline common security response tasks and enhance efficiency.
   

  

 Certification: Valid CEH Certificate required

 On\-site Working

 About Selfanimate
 
 Selfanimate is an online video maker that allows customers to create customized videos using professionally designed templates. Customers can personalize videos with their own text, photographs, videos and music and create content for weddings, birthdays, festivals, invitations, greetings and business purposes.
 



 Selfanimate also provides customer assistance for video creation, template customization, account\-related queries and technical issues.
 


 Job Summary
 
 We are looking for a
 **customer\-focused and technically comfortable Customer Support Executive** 
 who can assist customers throughout their Selfanimate experience—from selecting a template and customizing their video to payment, rendering, downloading and sharing the final video.
 



 The candidate will be responsible for resolving customer queries promptly and professionally through email, chat, WhatsApp and support tickets.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
**1\. Customer Query Management** 




 ·     Respond to customer queries through email, chat, WhatsApp and other available support channels.
 



 ·     Understand customer requirements and provide accurate solutions.
 



 ·     Assist customers with creating and customizing videos.
 



 ·     Guide customers through the Selfanimate platform and its features.
 



**2\. Technical Support** 




 ·     Help customers troubleshoot issues related to:
 



 o  Login/sign\-up
 



 o  Template selection
 



 o  Text editing
 



 o  Image/video uploads
 



 o  Music/audio
 



 o  Video preview
 



 o  Rendering
 



 o  Payment
 



 o  Downloading
 



 o  Sharing
 



 ·     Identify technical issues and escalate them to the technical/product team where required.
 



**3\. Order \& Payment Support** 




 ·     Assist customers with payment\-related queries.
 



 ·     Help customers understand order status and video rendering.
 



 ·     Handle issues related to downloads and purchased videos.
 



 ·     Coordinate with the concerned team for payment or transaction\-related issues.
 



**4\. Video Customization Assistance** 




 ·     Guide customers on replacing text, uploading photographs/videos and selecting music.
 



 ·     Explain available customization options such as layouts, fonts, colours and other features.
 



 ·     Help customers understand preview, editing and finalization procedures.
 



**5\. Support Ticket Management** 




 ·     Monitor and respond to customer support tickets.
 



 ·     Maintain proper records of customer complaints and resolutions.
 



 ·     Follow up on unresolved issues until closure.
 



 ·     Escalate high\-priority or recurring issues to the appropriate department.
 



**6\. Customer Experience** 




 ·     Maintain a polite, empathetic and professional tone while communicating with customers.
 



 ·     Handle dissatisfied customers calmly and professionally.
 



 ·     Take ownership of customer issues until an appropriate resolution is provided.
 



 ·     Collect customer feedback and identify recurring pain points.
 



**7\. Internal Coordination** 




 ·     Coordinate with the technical, design, marketing and operations teams to resolve customer issues.
 



 ·     Report recurring technical or usability problems to the concerned team.
 



 ·     Communicate customer feedback that can help improve Selfanimate’s products and services.
 



**8\. Documentation \& Reporting** 




 ·     Maintain daily records of customer queries, complaints and resolutions.
 



 ·     Prepare daily/weekly support reports.
 



 ·     Track common issues and identify opportunities for process improvement.
 



 ·     Maintain accurate customer communication and ticket records.
 


 Required Skills
 
 ·     Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
 



 ·     Strong customer service orientation.
 



 ·     Good problem\-solving and troubleshooting ability.
 



 ·     Comfortable using websites, web applications and digital tools.
 



 ·     Basic understanding of video editing/customization platforms.
 



 ·     Good knowledge of email, chat and WhatsApp communication.
 



 ·     Ability to explain technical processes in simple language.
 



 ·     Patience and ability to handle difficult customers.
 



 ·     Good typing speed and computer skills.
 



 ·     Ability to work independently as well as in a team.
 


 Qualification \& Experience
 
**Qualification:** 
 Graduate in any discipline. A degree/diploma in Computer Applications, IT, Management or a related field would be an advantage.
 



**Experience:** 
 0–2 years in customer support, technical support, e\-commerce support, SaaS support or a similar role.
 



**Freshers:** 
 Candidates with excellent communication skills and strong computer knowledge may also be considered.
 


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 
 ·     First Response Time (FRT).
 



 ·     Average Resolution Time (ART).
 



 ·     Customer Satisfaction (CSAT).
 



 ·     Number of tickets resolved.
 



 ·     First Contact Resolution (FCR).
 



 ·     Customer complaint escalation rate.
 



 ·     Ticket closure rate.
 



 ·     Accuracy of responses.
 



 ·     Customer retention and positive feedback.
 



 ·     Quality and completeness of support documentation.
 


 Ideal Candidate
 
 The ideal candidate should be
 **patient, solution\-oriented, technologically comfortable and customer\-friendly** 
 . The person should be able to understand a customer’s problem quickly and explain the solution in a simple, step\-by\-step manner.
 


* Since Selfanimate supports customers in creating and customizing videos and provides support through digital channels, strong communication combined with basic technical troubleshooting skills is particularly important.

title: AI Creator & Automation Specialist
description:
**Don’t just use the tool. Understand the system.** 




  





**Position:** 
 AI Creator \& Automation Specialist
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
 Exceptional Freshers / Early Career Professionals / Self Taught Specialists
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time \| Onsite
 



  





**About The Company** 




**Akrisso Innovations Private Limited** 
  is an AI technology company built around a simple belief: 
 **AI is only as powerful as the human mind directing it** 
 . We look for people who know their craft deeply, think logically, question the obvious and use AI as a tool to extend their ability, not replace it.
 



 If you rely on AI to think, create or code for you, Akrisso may not be the right place. We are looking for people with the judgement, curiosity and skill to shape AI, control it and use it to create work that would not be possible otherwise
 



  





**About This Role** 




 We are looking for someone fascinated by the space between creativity and systems.
 



 Someone who does not stop after getting a result from an AI model.
 



  





 You want to know:
 



 Why did it work?
 



 Why did it fail?
 



 How can it become repeatable?
 



 How can it become controlled?
 



 How can multiple tools work together?
 



 How can the final output become genuinely good?
 



  





 This role requires both 
 **technical curiosity and aesthetic judgement** 
 .
 



 Knowing ComfyUI and n8n matters.
 



 Understanding what you are doing with them matters far more.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




**What You'll Do** 



* Build and refine creative AI workflows.
* Develop automation using n8n.
* Work with ComfyUI at a practical level.
* Connect tools and services through APIs and webhooks.
* Experiment with generative image, video and related technologies.
* Improve consistency and reliability of workflows.
* Troubleshoot failures logically.
* Evaluate emerging tools and models.
* Refine generated output using proper creative judgement.
* Document useful systems clearly.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 




**Your Craft** 




 You should have practical understanding of:
 


* ComfyUI
* n8n
* Generative AI workflows
* APIs
* Webhooks
* JSON
* Creative image/video pipelines
* Visual editing
* Basic automation logic



 Python knowledge is strongly valued.
 



  





**What We Notice** 




 We notice people who:
 


* Build strange experiments because they are curious.
* Have broken workflows and rebuilt them to understand why.
* Understand nodes and dependencies rather than just downloading workflows.
* Know the difference between a technically successful result and an aesthetically good one.
* Follow developments because they genuinely enjoy the field.
* Can explain why one workflow is more reliable than another.
* Think in systems rather than isolated prompts.



  





**AI \& Your Craft** 




 This is an AI\-focused role.
 



 But even here, tool dependency is not expertise.
 



 If you only know how to enter prompts into popular interfaces, this role will probably be too technical.
 



 We want someone who understands workflows, logic, failure, iteration and creative control.
 



  





**You Might Not Enjoy This Role If** 



* Your AI experience is mostly prompting.
* You copy workflows without understanding the nodes.
* You lose interest when something stops working.
* You wait for tutorials instead of investigating.
* You cannot judge whether the final visual output is actually good.



  





**To Apply** 




 Send to 
 **careers@akrisso.com** 




**Subject Line:** 
 "AI Creator \& Automation Specialist Application \- \[Your Full Name]":
 


* Your résumé.
* Examples of your AI work.
* Screenshots, videos, workflows or repositories where possible.



 And answer:
 



**What is the most unusual AI or automation workflow you have created independently? What problem were you trying to solve?**

title: Mobile App Developer (Native iOS, Native Android & Flutter)
description:
**Mobile App Developer (Native iOS, Native Android \& Flutter)** 




  





**About Obraz** 




 Obraz is an Applied AI Engineering partner specializing in secure, production\-grade Computer Vision systems for enterprise and defense sectors. We build scalable AI solutions that bridge advanced engineering with real\-world deployment across industries including Defense \& Surveillance, Healthcare Imaging, Industrial Automation, and Smart Infrastructure.
 



 Our focus is on building reliable, enterprise\-grade AI systems for global markets including the US, Europe, and the Middle East.
 



  





  





**The Opportunity** 




 We're looking for a skilled, versatile, and highly capable Mobile App Developer who specializes in building complete, standalone applications natively in both Swift (iOS) and Kotlin (Android), alongside proficiency in Flutter.
 



 This role is for a true polyglot mobile engineer. You must be completely comfortable dropping cross\-platform frameworks to build applications entirely the "native way" from the ground up when projects demand deep hardware integration, computer vision processing, LiDAR/ToF sensor access, and maximum performance.
 



 You'll work closely with Computer Vision engineers, AI/ML teams, Product Managers, and Design teams to develop scalable, accurate, and production\-ready applications for enterprise and healthcare use cases.
 



  





  





**What You'll Own** 




 • Design, develop, test, and maintain fully native, standalone applications built entirely in Swift (iOS) and Kotlin (Android) without relying on cross\-platform frameworks.
 



 • Design, develop, test, and maintain high\-quality cross\-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart for appropriate projects.
 



 • Build robust and seamless communication between Flutter and Native layers using MethodChannels and Platform Channels when utilizing a hybrid approach.
 



 • Build purely native applications that leverage both Apple's LiDAR/ARKit and Android's ToF/ARCore sensors to extract and process 3D depth data, spatial information, and point clouds.
 



 • Work directly with native camera APIs (AVFoundation on iOS and Camera2 API/CameraX on Android) to capture and process high\-resolution camera frames and buffers for AI model inference.
 



 • Integrate and deploy custom Machine Learning models natively using both Core ML (iOS) and TensorFlow Lite (Android).
 



 • Translate complex business requirements and UI/UX designs into functional, scalable, and intuitive mobile applications natively.
 



 • Implement scalable application architecture natively using MVVM, Clean Architecture, and established mobile design patterns specific to both the Apple and Google ecosystems.
 



 • Optimize application performance, memory usage, and responsiveness natively, particularly for heavy image, video, depth, and sensor\-data processing.
 



 • Implement local data storage and secure data handling using native technologies such as Core Data (iOS) and Room (Android).
 



 • Collaborate closely with AI/ML and Computer Vision engineers to integrate advanced algorithms into mobile applications.
 



 • Support end\-to\-end application deployment and releases through both App Store Connect and Google Play Console, including code signing and provisioning profiles.
 



  





  





**What Makes You a Great Fit** 




 • 3–6 years of professional experience in Mobile Application Development.
 



 • Proven ability to build complete, complex mobile applications from scratch using purely native toolchains (Xcode/Swift and Android Studio/Kotlin).
 



 • Strong proficiency in Flutter and Dart for building cross\-platform applications.
 



 • Strong experience bridging Flutter to native codebases via Platform Channels.
 



 • Proven experience working directly with native spatial computing frameworks including both ARKit (iOS) and ARCore (Android).
 



 • Experience interacting natively with hardware\-level sensors such as LiDAR, ToF, TrueDepth cameras, and gyroscopes.
 



 • Deep familiarity with handling raw camera buffers and video streams directly through native APIs (AVFoundation, CMSampleBuffer, and Camera2 API).
 



 • Strong understanding of native state management, application lifecycles, and memory management for both iOS and Android ecosystems.
 



 • Hands\-on experience integrating REST APIs and JSON\-based services natively.
 



 • Experience with Git and version control workflows.
 



 • Experience publishing apps independently to both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store, including managing certificates and provisioning profiles.
 



 • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills, especially related to spatial logic and native hardware constraints.
 



  





  





**Good to Have** 




 • Experience with OpenCV for mobile natively in C\+\+/Swift/Kotlin.
 



 • Knowledge of spatial mathematics, 3D geometry, coordinate systems, or point\-cloud processing.
 



 • Experience with modern native UI frameworks: both SwiftUI (iOS) and Jetpack Compose (Android).
 



 • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Fastlane, GitHub Actions) and mobile application deployment automation.
 



 • Previous experience building healthcare, medical imaging, measurement\-based, or enterprise applications.
 



  





  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 • Confidently switch between building purely native apps (Swift/Kotlin) and cross\-platform apps (Flutter) depending on the architectural needs of the project.
 



 • Deliver high\-quality, stable, and scalable mobile applications across all three paradigms (Native iOS, Native Android, Flutter).
 



 • Build accurate and reliable features using LiDAR, ToF, AR frameworks, and device\-level sensors natively across both OS ecosystems.
 



 • Ensure efficient processing of image, video, depth, and point\-cloud data natively.

**Why Obraz**

title: Firmware Engineer
description:
\# Firmware Engineer / Embedded Systems Engineer – Medical Devices
 



  





 INDQ is looking for a Firmware / Embedded Systems Engineer to develop reliable, production\-ready firmware for medical devices and advanced engineering products.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience with \*\*ESP32, STM32, Nordic Semiconductor platforms\*\*, sensor interfacing, communication protocols, real\-time embedded systems, and \*\*signal processing\*\*. The role will involve working closely with hardware, biomedical, mechanical, and product\-development teams to convert device requirements into robust embedded solutions.
 



  





 The candidate should be comfortable working from the \*\*sensor level to the complete device level\*\* — including peripheral interfacing, communication, data acquisition, signal processing, control algorithms, debugging, validation, and firmware documentation.
 



  





 \#\# Key Responsibilities
 



  





 \* Develop embedded firmware for \*\*ESP32, STM32, Nordic nRF52/nRF53/nRF54 and similar microcontrollers\*\*.
 



 \* Develop firmware for medical and healthcare devices involving sensors, actuators, displays, communication modules, and data acquisition systems.
 



 \* Interface and acquire data from various sensors such as:
 



  





  \* ECG / biopotential sensors
 



  \* PPG / SpO₂ sensors
 



  \* Temperature sensors
 



  \* Pressure sensors
 



  \* IMUs
 



  \* Load cells
 



  \* Optical sensors
 



  \* Analog front ends (AFEs)
 



  \* Other biomedical and industrial sensors
 



 \* Implement \*\*signal conditioning and digital signal\-processing algorithms\*\* for noisy physiological and sensor data.
 



 \* Develop algorithms for filtering, noise reduction, feature extraction, signal quality assessment, and parameter estimation.
 



 \* Work with ADCs, DACs, timers, PWM, interrupts, DMA, GPIO, RTC, watchdogs, and low\-power peripherals.
 



 \* Develop and debug communication interfaces including: UART, SPI, I²C, RS\-232 / RS\-485, CAN / CAN\-FD, USB, BLE, Wi\-Fi, Ethernet
 



  





 \* Develop BLE applications and profiles using Nordic/Zephyr or equivalent platforms.
 



 \* Interface embedded systems with mobile applications, PCs, cloud platforms, and external medical equipment where required.
 



 \* Implement real\-time control and state\-machine\-based firmware.
 



 \* Develop bootloaders, firmware update mechanisms, and \*\*OTA updates\*\* where required.
 



 \* Implement data logging, memory management, EEPROM/Flash storage, and configuration management.
 



 \* Perform hardware bring\-up and board\-level debugging.
 



 \* Debug firmware using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, JTAG/SWD debuggers, and other laboratory equipment.
 



 \* Analyze communication buses and troubleshoot hardware–firmware integration issues.
 



 \* Optimize firmware for \*\*performance, memory usage, power consumption, and reliability\*\*.
 



 \* Develop firmware with appropriate fault handling, watchdog mechanisms, error detection, and recovery mechanisms.
 



 \* Participate in firmware verification, validation, and system\-level testing.
 



 \* Maintain firmware architecture, source\-code documentation, interface specifications, test procedures, and technical documentation.
 



 \* Work within a structured \*\*medical\-device product\-development and quality\-management environment\*\*.
 



  





 Experience with \*\*FreeRTOS, Zephyr RTOS, or other RTOS environments\*\* is highly desirable.
 



  





 \#\#\# Programming
 



  





 \* Strong proficiency in \*\*Embedded C\*\*
 



 \* Good knowledge of C\+\+
 



 \* Pointers, structures, unions, bit manipulation, memory management
 



 \* Interrupt\-driven programming
 



 \* DMA\-based data acquisition
 



 \* Timers and peripheral programming
 



 \* State machines
 



 \* Multithreading / RTOS concepts
 



 \* Memory\-constrained embedded programming
 



 \* Version control using \*\*Git\*\*
 



  





 The candidate should be able to \*\*read a communication protocol specification and implement/debug the protocol at firmware level\*\*.
 



  





 Signal Processing
 



  





 This is an important part of the role.
 



  





 The candidate should have practical understanding of:
 



  





 \* Digital signal processing
 



 \* Sampling theory
 



 \* Nyquist theorem
 



 \* Digital filtering
 



 \* Moving\-average filters
 



 \* FIR / IIR filters
 



 \* Low\-pass / high\-pass / band\-pass filtering
 



 \* Notch filtering
 



 \* Noise reduction
 



 \* Baseline removal
 



 \* Signal normalization
 



 \* FFT / frequency\-domain analysis
 



 \* Peak detection
 



 \* Feature extraction
 



 \* Signal quality assessment
 



 \* Sensor fusion
 



 \* Real\-time signal processing on microcontrollers
 



 \-
 



 Knowledge of the following is an advantage:
 



  





 \* Medical\-device firmware development
 



 \* Physiological signal acquisition
 



 \* ECG / PPG / SpO₂
 



 \* Patient monitoring systems
 



 \* Wearable medical devices
 



 \* Diagnostic devices
 



 \* Therapeutic devices
 



 \* Sensor calibration
 



 \* Measurement accuracy and repeatability
 



 \* Firmware verification and validation
 



 \* Risk\-based development
 



 \* IEC 62304
 



 \* IEC 60601
 



 \* ISO 13485
 



 \* ISO 14971
 



 \* Software lifecycle documentation
 



 \* Design inputs / outputs
 



 \* Verification and validation
 



  





 \#\# What We Are Looking For
 



  





 We are looking for someone who can \*\*independently take ownership of firmware development\*\*, rather than someone who only writes basic microcontroller code.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should be able to:
 



  





 \*\*Understand requirement → select architecture → interface hardware → acquire sensor data → process signals → implement algorithms → establish communication → debug → validate → document → release production firmware.\*\*
 



  





 Strong \*\*hands\-on problem\-solving ability\*\* is more important than knowing a large number of platforms theoretically.
 



  





 \#\# Experience
 



  





 \*\*Recommended experience:\*\* 2–5\+ years in embedded/firmware development.
 



  





 Freshers with exceptional hands\-on experience in embedded systems, biomedical instrumentation, signal processing, and significant personal/academic projects may also be considered.
 



  





 \#\# Education
 



  





 Preferred backgrounds:
 



  





 \* B.E. / B.Tech – Electronics \& Communication Engineering
 



 \* B.E. / B.Tech – Electrical / Electronics Engineering
 



 \* B.E. / B.Tech – Biomedical Engineering
 



 \* B.E. / B.Tech – Instrumentation Engineering
 



 \* M.E. / M.Tech in relevant fields
 



  





 Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
 



  





 \#\# Key Skills / Keywords
 



  





 \*\*Embedded C \| C\+\+ \| ESP32 \| STM32 \| Nordic nRF52/nRF53/nRF54 \| ARM Cortex\-M \| FreeRTOS \| Zephyr \| UART \| SPI \| I²C \| RS\-485 \| CAN \| USB \| BLE \| Wi\-Fi \| TCP/IP \| MQTT \| ADC \| DAC \| DMA \| RTOS \| Sensor Interfacing \| Biomedical Sensors \| Signal Processing \| DSP \| FIR \| IIR \| FFT \| ECG \| PPG \| SpO₂ \| IMU \| Data Acquisition \| Hardware Debugging \| JTAG \| SWD \| Git \| Firmware Validation \| Medical Devices\*\*

title: XR Deployment Specialist
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 The Extended Reality (XR) team is seeking an XR Deployment Specialist, to manage IT deployment and configuration of XR solutions, ensuring new devices are properly integrated into the company's network infrastructure across diverse global locations. The position will focus on two primary functions: XR Device Deployment \& Integration and Technical Support \& Operations. The first area involves the end\-to\-end setup, configuration, and rollout of XR hardware and software. The second concentrates on providing expert\-level troubleshooting, supporting local IT teams, and maintaining the operational health of the deployed XR device fleet. Given the focus on specialized hardware within an enterprise IT framework, the ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with XR devices (e.g., Meta Quest, HoloLens), proficiency in Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms, and a strong background in enterprise networking and IT support protocols.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* XR Deployment and Integration
+ Execute the end\-to\-end deployment of XR hardware (headsets, controllers) and software at various company locations, ensuring proper initial setup.
+ Develop and execute deployment plans including timelines, staging environments, and rollback procedures
+ Configure and enroll XR devices using Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms to ensure compliance with company security policies and standards.
+ Collaborate with local IT personnel to prepare and validate network readiness, including Wi\-Fi configuration, VPN access, and firewall rules for seamless XR device operation.
+ Support local IT personnel to install, test, and validate required software and applications for specific XR use cases prior to user handover.
+ Integrate XR solutions with enterprise systems such as Active Directory for user authentication and management.
+ Collaborate with developers to validate application builds and ensure production\-readiness prior to launch.

* Technical Support and Operations
+ Act as a technical specialist to diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network connectivity issues for deployed XR devices.
+ Provide expert guidance and troubleshooting assistance to local IT teams and end\-users to resolve technical challenges.
+ Monitor usage analytics, performance metrics, and tickets to proactively identify and resolve systemic issues.
+ Create and maintain detailed documentation for deployment procedures, device configurations, and troubleshooting guides.
+ Create technical guides, quick\-start materials, and on\-site support resources for diverse user groups.
+ Contribute to the development of deployment standards, playbooks, and SOPs


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s of Engineering degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in IT support, systems administration, or technology deployment roles.

* CompTIA Network\+ certification.
* Experience with IT support and operations within enterprise environments.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Solid understanding of IT infrastructure and network troubleshooting.
* Experience working with ServiceNow.
* Knowledge of Active Directory and enterprise user authentication systems.
* Hands\-on experience with Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms such as Intune, Arbor XR, ManageXR, and VMware Workspace ONE.

* Experience with XR application packaging formats such as APK and MSIX.
* Understanding of Local Area Networks (LAN), Virtual Private Networks (VPN), and Wi\-Fi 6/6E technologies.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure environments.
* Strong analytical skills and collaborative mindset.

title: Full Stack Developer – AI Products
description:
**We need developers who can code before AI enters the room.** 




  





**Position:** 
 Full Stack Developer
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
 Exceptional Freshers / Early\-Career Developers
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time \| Onsite
 



  





**About The Company** 




**Akrisso Innovations Private Limited** 
  is an AI technology company built around a simple belief: 
 **AI is only as powerful as the human mind directing it** 
 . We look for people who know their craft deeply, think logically, question the obvious and use AI as a tool to extend their ability, not replace it.
 



 If you rely on AI to think, create or code for you, Akrisso may not be the right place. We are looking for people with the judgement, curiosity and skill to shape AI, control it and use it to create work that would not be possible otherwise.
 



  





**About This Role** 




 We are looking for developers who genuinely enjoy programming.
 



 Not people who entered development because AI made writing code easier.
 



 You should understand code well enough to write it, read it, debug it, challenge it and improve it yourself.
 



  





 Modern AI coding tools can make a good developer significantly faster.
 



 We encourage intelligent use of them.
 



 But they should extend your ability, not create the illusion of it.
 



 If an AI coding assistant disappeared tomorrow, you should still know how to build.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




**What You'll Do** 



* Build modern web applications.
* Work across frontend and backend development.
* Develop APIs and application logic.
* Work with databases and authentication.
* Translate product requirements into functioning software.
* Debug systematically.
* Improve performance, maintainability and reliability.
* Review and improve code.
* Contribute to technical decisions.
* Integrate modern AI enabled functionality when appropriate.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 




**Your Craft** 




 You should understand several of:
 


* JavaScript
* TypeScript
* React
* Next.js
* Node.js
* REST APIs
* SQL and databases
* HTML
* CSS
* Git
* Authentication
* Data structures and programming fundamentals



 Python, Docker, cloud environments and AI integrations are useful additions.
 



  





**But More Importantly** 




 You should understand:
 


* Variables.
* Functions.
* Data flow.
* State.
* APIs.
* Asynchronous behaviour.
* Databases.
* Debugging.
* Architecture.
* Why your code behaves the way it does.



  





 Framework knowledge changes.
 



 Programming ability remains.
 



  





**What We Notice** 




 We notice developers who:
 


* Have built something outside an assignment.
* Read documentation.
* Enjoy debugging.
* Can explain code without hiding behind terminology.
* Know when their architecture is becoming unnecessarily complicated.
* Refactor because they understand why it matters.
* Have discovered their own mistakes and corrected them.
* Ask questions about the problem rather than immediately writing code.



  





**AI \& Your Craft** 




 You may use AI coding assistants.
 



 In fact, we expect strong developers to learn how to use modern tools intelligently.
 



 But you remain responsible for every line of code you ship.
 



  





 If AI generates something:
 



**You should be able to read it.** 




**Explain it.** 




**Debug it.** 




**Modify it.** 




**Reject it when it is wrong.** 




  





 We are not looking for prompt to code developers.
 



 We are looking for engineers.
 



  





**You Might Not Enjoy This Role If** 



* You cannot comfortably write code without AI.
* You copy code until something runs.
* You avoid debugging.
* You know frameworks but lack programming fundamentals.
* You need every feature broken into exact implementation instructions.
* You view anything outside your preferred stack as somebody else's problem.



  





**To Apply** 




 Send to 
 **careers@akrisso.com** 




**Subject Line:** 
 "FullStack Developer Application \- \[Your Full Name]":
 


* Your résumé.
* GitHub.
* Your strongest working project.



 And answer:
 



**Show us one technical problem you solved primarily through your own reasoning. What made it difficult?** 




  





 Shortlisted candidates should expect part of the technical assessment to evaluate coding fundamentals without AI assistance.

 Logistics

title: Creative Designer & Video Editor
description:
**For people who understand why something looks, feels and sounds right.** 




  





**Motion • UI/UX • Visual Storytelling** 




  





**Position:** 
 Creative Designer \& Video Editor
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
 Exceptional Freshers / Early\-Career Professionals
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time \| Onsite
 



  





**About The Company** 




**Akrisso Innovations Private Limited** 
  is an AI technology company built around a simple belief: 
 **AI is only as powerful as the human mind directing it** 
 . We look for people who know their craft deeply, think logically, question the obvious and use AI as a tool to extend their ability, not replace it.
 



 If you rely on AI to think, create or code for you, Akrisso may not be the right place. We are looking for people with the judgement, curiosity and skill to shape AI, control it and use it to create work that would not be possible otherwise.
 



  





**About This Role** 




 We are looking for a creative professional who understands that good design is not decoration, and good editing is not the arrangement of clips.
 



  





 You should understand how 
 **colour creates emotion, composition directs attention, sound changes perception, typography creates personality, motion controls energy, and interface design influences how people feel while using a product.** 




  





 This is a multidisciplinary creative role across 
 **video, motion, visual design, brand communication and the visual side of UI/UX** 
 .
 



  





 You should be equally comfortable thinking about a frame, a logo, a screen, a transition, a colour palette or a piece of sound.
 



  





 Software matters.
 



 But judgement matters more.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




**What You'll Do** 



* Edit high quality video across multiple formats.
* Create motion graphics, animation and visual transitions.
* Design visual assets for digital platforms and brand communication.
* Contribute to the visual side of UI/UX for web and product interfaces.
* Work with typography, layout, colour, imagery and composition.
* Translate ideas and briefs into clear visual concepts.
* Build visual stories that connect with the intended audience.
* Work with sound, music and pacing to strengthen emotion and impact.
* Develop and refine concepts beyond the obvious first solution.
* Explore AI\-assisted creative tools where they genuinely improve the work.
* Maintain a consistently high standard across every medium.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 




**Your Craft** 




 You should have strong practical understanding of:
 


* Adobe Premiere Pro
* Adobe After Effects
* Photoshop / Illustrator or equivalent design tools
* Figma
* Video editing
* Motion design
* Basic animation
* UI visual design
* Composition
* Typography
* Colour theory
* Visual hierarchy
* Layout
* Pacing
* Sound and audio rhythm
* Brand and visual identity fundamentals



  





 Knowledge of DaVinci Resolve, Blender, generative creative tools or additional design software is useful.
 



 But knowing more software will never compensate for weak creative judgement.
 



  





**What We Mean by Visual Intelligence** 




 We are looking for someone who understands that:
 


* The same colour can communicate trust, urgency, luxury or danger depending on context.
* A typeface changes the personality of a message before the words are even read.
* A good interface guides attention without making the user think about the interface itself.
* Silence can sometimes create more impact than music.
* Motion should have a reason.
* A logo can be technically clean and still say nothing.
* A beautiful screen can still be poor design if the hierarchy is wrong.
* A visually impressive film can still fail if the audience feels nothing.



  





 You should be able to look at creative work and explain 
 **why it succeeds or why it fails.** 




  





**What We Notice** 




 We notice people who:
 


* See awkward spacing, poor typography or visual imbalance without being told.
* Understand emotional tone, not just visual polish.
* Think about how different audiences may react to the same design.
* Can connect a creative choice to a brand, story or purpose.
* Study advertising, cinema, interfaces, branding, photography or sound because they genuinely enjoy understanding them.
* Can take inspiration without copying.
* Have personal experiments that were never commissioned.
* Revisit their own work because they know it can be better.
* Care about small details even when nobody else notices them.



  





**AI \& Your Craft** 




 AI can generate an image.
 



 It cannot decide whether the image communicates the right emotion.
 



 AI can generate a logo.
 



 It cannot decide whether the identity belongs to the brand.
 



 AI can generate a video.
 



 It cannot decide whether the pacing, sound and story connect with people.
 



 AI can suggest an interface.
 



 It cannot replace your understanding of hierarchy, usability and visual judgement.
 



  





 We expect you to use AI intelligently where it expands creative possibilities.
 



 But AI should extend your ability, not create it.
 



  





 If the tools disappeared tomorrow, you should still understand 
 **design, editing, motion and visual communication.** 




  





**You Might Not Enjoy This Role If** 



* You depend heavily on templates.
* You need a reference before you can begin every piece of work.
* You think good design simply means making something look attractive.
* You treat colour as decoration rather than communication.
* You use music without thinking about the emotion it creates.
* You believe more effects automatically make something more creative.
* You rely on AI to make your creative decisions.
* You stop once the work is technically complete.



  





**To Apply** 




 Send us to 
 **careers@akrisso.com** 




**Subject Line:** 
 "Creative Designer \& Video Editor Application \- \[Your Full Name]":
 


* Your résumé.
* Your portfolio or showreel.
* Your three strongest pieces of work across any combination of video, motion, design or UI.



 Then answer:
 



**Choose one piece from your portfolio and explain how your choices of colour, composition, motion, interface or sound were intended to make the audience feel or respond in a particular way.** 




  





 We are interested in what you created.
 



 But we are equally interested in whether you understand 
 **why you created it that way.**

At Aristocrat, we are committed to crafting world\-class gaming experiences that engage players worldwide. Our mission is to bring happiness to life by unlocking the potential of play. As a Technical Lead, you will have a key role in reaching this goal. Our studio culture values quality, personal ownership, and a collaborative atmosphere, making this a highly rewarding opportunity for dedicated developers.
   

  

 In this role, you will take charge of developing casino games for a variety of cabinets and regions. This position presents the challenge of combining intricate art, game mathematics, and regulatory requirements, offering a varied and engaging experience with every game you create. Your efforts will directly influence our capacity to bring high\-quality games to various markets effectively.
   

  

 What You'll Do
 * Analyze game requirements in collaboration with technical leads and game designers
* Build slot games tailored to multiple cabinets and markets
* Engage in coding, code reviews, unit testing, memory profiling, and other code hygiene processes
* Ensure game quality and timely delivery to market
* Collaborate with a dedicated team of artists, game designers, developers, and test engineers
* Continuously improve processes and contribute to a culture of excellence
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues to maintain flawless game performance
* Implement new features and improvements in existing games
* Keep up\-to\-date with industry trends and integrate guidelines into game development
* Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior developers


 What We're Looking For
 * At least 5 years of experience in software development
* Outstanding programming skills in C\+\+ under Windows and Linux operating systems
* Strong skills in object\-oriented development, algorithms, and data structures
* Demonstrated knowledge of the software development life cycle and engineering concepts
* A degree in Computer Science (B Tech/BE/MCA) or equivalent experience
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Strong communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts
* Experience in game development is a plus
* Passion for delivering high\-quality, innovative gaming experiences


 Join Aristocrat, where your expertise will contribute to crafting flawless casino games that entertain millions of players worldwide!
   

  

 Why Aristocrat?
   

  

 Aristocrat is a world leader in gaming content and technology, and a top\-tier publisher of free\-to\-play mobile games. We deliver great performance for our B2B customers and bring joy to the lives of the millions of people who love to play our casino and mobile games. And while we focus on fun, we never forget our responsibilities. We strive to lead the way in responsible gameplay, and to lift the bar in company governance, employee wellbeing and sustainability. We’re a diverse business united by shared values and an inspiring mission to bring joy to life through the power of play.
   

  

 We aim to create an environment where individual differences are valued, and all employees have the opportunity to realize their potential. We welcome and encourage applications from all people regardless of age, gender, race, ethnicity, cultural background, disability status or LGBTQ\+ identity. EEO M/F/D/V
 * World Leader in Gaming Entertainment
* Robust benefits package
* Global career opportunities


 Our Values
 * All about the Player
* Talent Unleashed
* Collective Brilliance
* Good Business Good Citizen


**Travel Expectations**
 None
   

  

**Additional Information**
*At this time, we are unable to sponsor work visas for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the job posting location for this position on a full\-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship.*
